title.zh: 卷五 本紀第五 文帝
title.raw: 卷五 本紀第五 文帝 Volume 5 Annals 5: Emperor Wen

sentences.zh: 景平二年七月中，少帝廢。

translations.literal: In the middle of the seventh month of the second year of Jingping, the Young Emperor was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: In the middle of the seventh month of Jingping 2 (424), the Young Emperor was deposed.

sentences.zh: 百官備法駕奉迎，入奉皇統。

translations.literal: The hundred officials prepared the imperial carriage and escort to welcome him, entering to receive the imperial succession.
translations.idiomatic: The officials prepared the imperial carriage and escort to welcome him and install him in the imperial succession.

sentences.zh: 行臺至江陵，進璽紱。

translations.literal: When the mobile secretariat reached Jiangling, they presented the seal and cord.
translations.idiomatic: When the mobile secretariat reached Jiangling, they presented the imperial seal and cord.

sentences.zh: 侍中臣琇、散騎常侍臣嶷之、中書監尚書令護軍將軍建城縣公臣亮、左衞將軍臣景仁、給事中游擊將軍龍鄉縣侯臣隆、越騎校尉都亭侯臣綱、給事黃門侍郎臣孔璩之、散騎侍郎臣劉思考、員外散騎侍郎臣潘盛、中書侍郎臣何尚之、羽林監封陽縣開國侯臣蕭思話、長兼尚書左丞德陽縣侯臣孫康、吏部郎中騎都尉臣張茂度、儀曹郎中臣徐長琳、倉部郎中臣庾俊之、都官郎中臣袁洵等上表曰：「臣聞否泰相革，數窮則變，天道所以不謟，卜世所以靈長。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Chen Qiu, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Chen Yan-zhi, Supervisor of the Secretariat, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Defender-General of the Household, Duke of Jiancheng Chen Liang, General of the Left Guard Chen Jingren, Attendant-in-Ordinary and General of Roaming Attack, Marquis of Longxiang Chen Long, Colonel of Agile Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Chen Gang, Attendant of the Yellow Gate Chen Kong Qun-zhi, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Pan Sheng, Secretariat Attendant He Shang-zhi, Supervisor of the Forest of Feathers, Opening Marquis of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Concurrent Left Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel and Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Director of the Bureau of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Bureau of Granaries Yu Jun-zhi, Director of the Bureau of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial, saying: "We have heard that decline and prosperity alternate, that when the number is exhausted change comes—this is why the Way of Heaven does not keep silent, and why a dynasty’s allotted span may endure in spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Chen Qiu, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Chen Yan-zhi, Supervisor of the Secretariat and Director of the Imperial Secretariat Chen Liang, Defender-General of the Household and Duke of Jiancheng, General of the Left Guard Chen Jingren, Attendant-in-Ordinary and General of Roaming Attack Chen Long, Marquis of Longxiang, Colonel of Agile Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Chen Gang, Attendant of the Yellow Gate Kong Qun-zhi, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Supernumerary Regular Attendant Pan Sheng, Secretariat Attendant He Shang-zhi, Supervisor of the Forest of Feathers and Opening Marquis of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Concurrent Left Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel Zhang Maodu, Director of the Bureau of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Bureau of Granaries Yu Jun-zhi, Director of the Bureau of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial: "We have heard that decline and prosperity take turns, and that when fate’s number is spent change must come—this is why Heaven’s Way does not keep silent and why a dynasty’s allotted span may yet prove enduring."

sentences.zh: 乃者運距陵夷，王室艱晦，九服之命，靡所適歸，高祖之業，將墜于地。

translations.literal: Recently the cycle turned toward decline, the royal house fell into hardship, commands from the nine domains had nowhere to go, and the Founding Ancestor’s enterprise was about to crash to earth.
translations.idiomatic: Of late the cycle had turned toward decline: the royal house fell into hardship, commands from the nine domains had nowhere to go, and the Founding Ancestor’s enterprise was about to crash to earth.

sentences.zh: 賴基厚德深，人神同奬，社稷以寧，有生獲乂。

translations.literal: We relied on your deep virtue and thick foundation; men and spirits alike lent their aid, so the altars were secured and the living received peace.
translations.idiomatic: We relied on your deep virtue and firm foundation; men and spirits alike lent their aid, so the altars were secured and the people were brought to peace.

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下君德自然，聖明在御，孝悌著於家邦，風猷宣於蕃牧。

translations.literal: We humbly consider that Your Majesty’s sovereign virtue is natural, your sagely clarity holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty shine in the clan and state, and your moral influence is proclaimed in the frontier provinces.
translations.idiomatic: We humbly consider that Your Majesty’s sovereign virtue is innate, your sagely clarity holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty shine at home and abroad, and your moral influence is proclaimed in the frontier provinces.

sentences.zh: 是以徵祥雜沓，符瑞㸌煇。

translations.literal: Therefore auspicious signs have crowded in and talismans blazed with splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore auspicious signs have crowded in and portents blazed with splendor.

sentences.zh: 宗廟神靈，乃眷西顧，萬邦黎獻，望景託生。

translations.literal: The spirits of the ancestral temples have turned their gaze westward; the myriad states and all peoples look to your radiance and entrust their lives to you.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits of the ancestral temples have turned their gaze westward; the myriad states and all peoples look to your radiance and entrust their lives to you.

sentences.zh: 臣等忝荷朝列，豫充將命，復集休明之運，再覩太平之業。

translations.literal: We who unworthily bear office in the court were privileged to carry your commission, and again gather in this flourishing age, once more beholding the enterprise of great peace.
translations.idiomatic: We who unworthily bear office at court were privileged to carry your commission; we gather again in this flourishing age and once more behold the enterprise of great peace.

sentences.zh: 行臺至止，瞻望城闕，不勝喜說鳧藻之情，謹詣門拜表以聞。

translations.literal: The mobile secretariat has arrived; gazing upon the city towers, we cannot contain our joy and the feeling of ducks on the waves—we respectfully come to the gate to submit this memorial for your notice.
translations.idiomatic: The mobile secretariat has arrived; gazing upon the city towers, we cannot contain our joy—we respectfully come to the gate to submit this memorial for your notice.

sentences.zh: 」上答曰：「皇運艱弊，數鍾屯夷，仰惟崇基，感尋國故，永慕厥躬，悲慨交集。

translations.literal: " The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been hard pressed, the number has struck difficulty and calamity; looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel and seek the state’s past, ever longing for that person—grief and indignation mingle.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been hard pressed and fate has struck difficulty and calamity. Looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel and seek the state’s past, ever longing for that person—grief and indignation mingle within me.

sentences.zh: 賴七百祚永，股肱忠賢，故能休否以泰，天人式序。

translations.literal: We relied on the seven hundred years’ enduring mandate and loyal, worthy ministers at the throne, and thus decline could turn to prosperity and Heaven and men could take their proper order.
translations.idiomatic: We relied on the seven hundred years’ enduring mandate and on loyal, worthy ministers at the throne, and thus decline could turn to prosperity and Heaven and men could take their proper order.

sentences.zh: 猥以不德，謬降大命，顧己兢悸，何以克堪。

translations.literal: I am unworthy and have wrongly received the great mandate; looking upon myself I am fearful and trembling—how could I bear it?
translations.idiomatic: I am unworthy and have wrongly received the great mandate; looking upon myself I am fearful and trembling—how could I bear it?

sentences.zh: 輒當暫歸朝庭，展哀陵寢，并與賢彥申寫所懷。

translations.literal: I shall for the present return to the court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy ministers set forth what is in my heart.
translations.idiomatic: I shall for the present return to the court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy ministers set forth what is in my heart.

sentences.zh: 望體其心，勿為辭費。

translations.literal: I hope you will enter into my feelings and do not make your words elaborate.
translations.idiomatic: I hope you will enter into my feelings and do not make your words elaborate.

sentences.zh: 」府州佐史並稱臣，請題牓諸門，一依宮省，上不許。

translations.literal: " The prefectural and district aides all styled themselves ministers and asked to inscribe placards on the gates, all according to the palace regulations; the Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: " The prefectural and district aides all styled themselves ministers and asked to inscribe placards on the gates as at the palace; the Emperor did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，發江陵。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day he set out from Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day he set out from Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，車駕至京城。

translations.literal: On bingshen day of the eighth month the imperial carriage reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the eighth month the imperial carriage reached the capital.

sentences.zh: [1]丁酉，謁初寧陵，還於中堂即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On dingyou day he visited the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and thereupon assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day he visited the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and thereupon assumed the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 元嘉元年秋八月丁酉，大赦天下，改景平二年為元嘉元年。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Yuanjia, on dingyou day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and the second year of Jingping was changed to the first year of Yuanjia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Yuanjia 1 (424), on dingyou day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and Jingping 2 was changed to Yuanjia 1.

sentences.zh: 文武賜位二等，逋租宿債勿復收。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted two ranks of promotion; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were granted two ranks of promotion; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以行撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦為撫軍將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Acting Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Jing Province Xie Hui was made Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Acting Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Jing Province Xie Hui was confirmed as Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，司空、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之進位司徒，衞將軍、江州刺史王弘進位司空，中書監、護軍將軍傅亮加左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦進號衞將軍，鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟進號征北將軍。

translations.literal: On guimao day Minister of Works, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province Xu Xian-zhi was promoted to Grand Minister, Guards General and Inspector of Jiang Province Wang Hong was promoted to Minister of Works, Supervisor of the Secretariat and Defender-General Fu Liang was given the additional title of Left Grand Master of the Palace with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies, Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Jing Province Xie Hui was advanced in title to Guards General, and Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province Tan Daoji was advanced in title to Campaigning-North General.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Xu Xian-zhi, Minister of Works, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province, was promoted to Grand Minister; Wang Hong, Guards General and Inspector of Jiang Province, was promoted to Minister of Works; Fu Liang, Supervisor of the Secretariat and Defender-General, was given the additional title of Left Grand Master of the Palace with privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies; Xie Hui, Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Jing Province, was advanced to Guards General; and Tan Daoji, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was advanced to Campaigning-North General.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，追尊所生胡婕妤為皇太后，諡曰章后。

translations.literal: On jiachen day his birth mother, Lady Hu the Talented Lady, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager with the posthumous title Empress Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day his birth mother, Lady Hu the Talented Lady, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager with the posthumous title Empress Zhang.

sentences.zh: 衞將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康進號驃騎將軍，冠軍將軍、南豫州刺史義恭進號撫軍將軍，封江夏王。

translations.literal: Guards General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was advanced in title to General of Agile Cavalry, and General Who Conquers the Champions and Inspector of Southern Yu Province Yigong was advanced to Pacifying-Army General and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: Guards General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was advanced to General of Agile Cavalry, and General Who Conquers the Champions and Inspector of Southern Yu Province Yigong was advanced to Pacifying-Army General and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 立第六皇弟義宣為竟陵王，第七皇弟義季為衡陽王。

translations.literal: The sixth younger imperial brother Yixuan was established as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger imperial brother Yiji as Prince of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth younger imperial brother Yixuan was established as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger imperial brother Yiji as Prince of Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以豫州刺史劉粹為雍州刺史，驍騎將軍管義之為豫州刺史，南蠻校尉到彥之為中領軍。

translations.literal: On wushen day Inspector of Yu Province Liu Cui was made Inspector of Yong Province, General of Valiant Cavalry Guan Yizhi was made Inspector of Yu Province, and Colonel Director of the Southern Man Dao Yanzhi was made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Liu Cui, Inspector of Yu Province, was made Inspector of Yong Province; Guan Yizhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, was made Inspector of Yu Province; and Dao Yanzhi, Colonel Director of the Southern Man, was made General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 己酉，減荊、湘二州今年稅布之半。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the cloth tax of Jing and Xiang provinces for this year was reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the cloth tax of Jing and Xiang provinces for this year was reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，立妃袁氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On bingzi day of the ninth month Consort Yuan was established as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the ninth month Consort Yuan was established as Empress.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙寅，司徒徐羨之、尚書令傅亮奉表歸政，上始親覽。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, on bingyin day, Grand Minister Xu Xian-zhi and Director of the Imperial Secretariat Fu Liang submitted memorials returning government to the Emperor, and the Emperor for the first time personally reviewed affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, on bingyin day, Grand Minister Xu Xian-zhi and Director of the Imperial Secretariat Fu Liang submitted memorials returning government to the Emperor, and the Emperor for the first time personally reviewed affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕祠南郊，[2]大赦天下。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb; a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，左將軍、徐州刺史王仲德進號安北將軍。

translations.literal: On yichou day of the third month General of the Left and Inspector of Xu Province Wang Zhongde was advanced in title to Pacifying-North General.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day of the third month Wang Zhongde, General of the Left and Inspector of Xu Province, was advanced to Pacifying-North General.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊寅，特進謝澹卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on wuyin day, Special Grand Master Xie Dan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wuyin day, Special Grand Master Xie Dan died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲申，以關中流民出漢川，置京兆、扶風、馮翊等郡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiashen day, because displaced persons from Guanzhong had come out to the Han River, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Pingyi were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiashen day, because displaced persons from Guanzhong had come out to the Han River, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Pingyi were established.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康為開府儀同三司，新除司空王弘為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，以右軍長史江恒為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiyou day General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu Province Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was given the privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies; the newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies; and Jiang Heng, Chief Clerk of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was given privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies; the newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry with the same privilege; and Jiang Heng, Chief Clerk of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸酉，以前將軍楊玄為征西將軍、北秦州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on guiyou day, former General Yang Xuan was made Campaigning-West General and Inspector of Northern Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on guiyou day, former General Yang Xuan was made Campaigning-West General and Inspector of Northern Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之，尚書令、護軍將軍、左光祿大夫傅亮，有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, on bingyin day, Grand Minister and Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat and Inspector of Yang Province Xu Xian-zhi, and Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Defender-General, and Left Grand Master of the Palace Fu Liang, were guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, on bingyin day, Xu Xian-zhi, Grand Minister, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province, and Fu Liang, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Defender-General, and Left Grand Master of the Palace, were found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 遣中領軍到彥之、征北將軍檀道濟討荊州刺史謝晦，上親率六師西征。

translations.literal: General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and Campaigning-North General Tan Daoji were sent to attack Inspector of Jing Province Xie Hui; the Emperor personally led the Six Armies on a western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and Campaigning-North General Tan Daoji were sent to attack Xie Hui, Inspector of Jing Province; the Emperor personally led the Six Armies on a western campaign.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以車騎大將軍、江州刺史王弘為司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改為荊州刺史，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史江夏王義恭改為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Province Wang Hong was made Grand Minister, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province; General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu Province Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was changed to Inspector of Jing Province; and Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Southern Yu Province Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was changed to Inspector of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Wang Hong, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Province, was made Grand Minister, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province; Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was reassigned as Inspector of Jing Province; and Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was reassigned as Inspector of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以前護軍將軍趙倫之為鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On jisi day former Defender-General Zhao Lunzhi was made General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day former Defender-General Zhao Lunzhi was made General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌，皇子劭生。

translations.literal: On bingxu day of the intercalary month the imperial son Shao was born.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the intercalary month the imperial son Shao was born.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，繫囚見徒，一皆原赦。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao day, prisoners awaiting trial and convicts in service were all pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao day, prisoners awaiting trial and convicts in service were all pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以金紫光祿大夫王敬弘為尚書左僕射，豫章太守鄭鮮之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Grand Master of the Palace with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Wang Jinghong was made Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Administrator of Zhang Commandery Zheng Xian-zhi was made Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Wang Jinghong, Grand Master of the Palace with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was made Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Zheng Xian-zhi, Administrator of Zhang Commandery, was made Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Administrator of Jian’an Pan Sheng was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian’an, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: [3]庚申，特進范泰加光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Special Grand Master Fan Tai was given the additional title of Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Special Grand Master Fan Tai was given the additional title of Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 是日，車駕發京師。

translations.literal: That day the imperial carriage set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That day the imperial carriage set out from the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，到彥之、檀道濟大破謝晦於隱磯。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕自蕪湖反斾。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，擒晦於延頭，送京師伏誅。

translations.literal: On jimao day Hui was captured at Yantou and sent to the capital, where he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Hui was captured at Yantou and sent to the capital, where he was executed.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinsi day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinsi day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙未，以征北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟為征南大將軍、江州刺史，中領軍到彥之為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on yiwei day, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province Tan Daoji was made Campaigning-South Grand General and Inspector of Jiang Province, and General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on yiwei day, Tan Daoji, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Campaigning-South Grand General and Inspector of Jiang Province, and Dao Yanzhi, General of the Central Army, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以後將軍長沙王義欣為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Rear General Prince of Changsha Yixin was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Prince of Changsha Yixin, Rear General, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，驃騎大將軍、涼州牧大沮渠蒙遜改為車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On yisi day Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Liang Province Juqu Mengxun was changed to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Juqu Mengxun, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Liang Province, was advanced to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「夫哲王宰世，廣達四聰，猶巡嶽省方，採風觀政。

translations.literal: An edict said: "When a sage king governs the age, he broadly extends the four hearings, yet still tours the mountains to inspect the regions, gathers the winds to observe government.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "When a sage king governs the age, he broadly extends the four hearings, yet still tours the mountains to inspect the regions and gathers the winds to observe how government is conducted.

sentences.zh: 所以情偽必審，幽遐罔滯，王澤無擁，九皐有聞者也。

translations.literal: Thus truth and falsehood are surely examined, the hidden and distant are not blocked, royal favor is not hoarded, and the nine marshes have a voice.
translations.idiomatic: Thus truth and falsehood are surely examined, the hidden and distant are not blocked, royal favor is not hoarded, and the nine marshes have a voice.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡薄，猥纂洪緒。

translations.literal: I, meager and slight, have presumptuously succeeded to the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: I, meager and slight, have presumptuously succeeded to the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 雖永念治道，志存昧旦，願言傅巖，發想宵寐，而丘園之秀，藏器未臻，物情民隱，尚隔視聽。

translations.literal: Though I ever bear governing the Way in mind and keep my purpose at dawn, longing to speak of Fu Yue I am stirred even in sleep—yet the worthy in hill and dell, their talent still unreached, the people’s feelings and hidden grievances still lie beyond sight and hearing.
translations.idiomatic: Though I ever bear governing the Way in mind and keep my purpose from dawn, longing to find a Fu Yue I am stirred even in sleep—yet the worthy in hill and dell remain unreached, and the people’s feelings and hidden grievances still lie beyond my sight and hearing.

sentences.zh: 乃眷區域，輟寢忘飡。

translations.literal: Turning my gaze upon the realm, I cease sleep and forget my meal.
translations.idiomatic: Turning my gaze upon the realm, I cease sleep and forget my meal.

sentences.zh: 今氛祲袪蕩，宇內寧晏，旌賢弘化，於是乎始。

translations.literal: Now the baleful vapors are swept away and the realm within is tranquil; to raise the worthy and spread transformation begins from this.
translations.idiomatic: Now the baleful vapors are swept away and the realm within is tranquil; to raise the worthy and spread transformation begins from this.

sentences.zh: 可遣大使巡行四方。

translations.literal: Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 其宰守稱職之良，閨蓽一介之善，詳悉列奏，勿或有遺。

translations.literal: Those district governors who perform their duties well, and every fine quality in cottage and thicket, are to be set forth in full memorials—let nothing be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: District governors who perform their duties well, and every fine quality in cottage and thicket, are to be set forth in full memorials—let nothing be omitted.

sentences.zh: 若刑獄不卹，政治乖謬，傷民害教者，具以事聞。

translations.literal: Where punishments and prisons are not compassionate, where government and teaching are perverse, harming the people and injuring instruction—report the matter in full.
translations.idiomatic: Where punishments and prisons lack compassion, or government and teaching are perverse and harm the people—report the matter in full.

sentences.zh: 其高年、鰥寡、幼孤、六疾不能自存者，可與郡縣優量賑給。

translations.literal: As for the aged, widowed, orphaned, young, and the six infirmities who cannot support themselves, the commanderies and districts may generously measure out relief and supply them.
translations.idiomatic: As for the aged, widowed, orphaned, young, and the six infirmities who cannot support themselves, the commanderies and districts may generously measure out relief and supply them.

sentences.zh: 博採輿誦，廣納嘉謀，務盡銜命之旨，俾若朕親覽焉。

translations.literal: Broadly gather what is heard from the roads, widely receive good counsel, and exhaust the intent of your commission as though I myself were reviewing it.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly gather what is heard from the roads, widely receive good counsel, and exhaust the intent of your commission as though I myself were reviewing it.

sentences.zh: 」丙午，車駕臨延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: " On bingwu day the imperial carriage attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingwu day the imperial carriage attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，以鎮軍將軍趙倫之為左光祿大夫、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei day of the sixth month General Who Pacifies the Army Zhao Lunzhi was made Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the sixth month Zhao Lunzhi, General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Army.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車駕又於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the imperial carriage again attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the imperial carriage again attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies.

sentences.zh: 丙子，又聽訟。

translations.literal: On bingzi day he again attended to cases.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day he again attended to cases.

sentences.zh: 以右衞王華為中護軍。

translations.literal: General of the Right Guard Wang Hua was made General of the Central Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hua, General of the Right Guard, was made General of the Central Guard.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊寅，以梁、南秦二州刺史吉翰為益州刺史，驃騎參軍劉道產為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on wuyin day, Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces Ji Han was made Inspector of Yi Province, and Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry Liu Daochan was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on wuyin day, Ji Han, Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was made Inspector of Yi Province, and Liu Daochan, Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以南蠻校尉劉遵考為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On jihai day Colonel Director of the Southern Man Liu Zunkao was made Inspector of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Liu Zunkao, Colonel Director of the Southern Man, was made Inspector of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，以中書侍郎蕭思話為青州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guichou day, Secretariat Attendant Xiao Sihua was made Inspector of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guichou day, Xiao Sihua, Secretariat Attendant, was made Inspector of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，前吳郡太守徐佩之謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On renxu day former Administrator of Wu Commandery Xu Peizhi plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Xu Peizhi, former Administrator of Wu Commandery, plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙亥朔，曲赦都邑百里內。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, on yihai day the new year, a partial amnesty was granted within a hundred li of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, on yihai day the new year, a partial amnesty was granted within a hundred li of the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，行幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao day, he traveled to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao day, he traveled to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，詔曰：「丹徒桑梓綢繆，大業攸始，踐境永懷，觸感罔極。

translations.literal: On bingzi day of the third month an edict said: "Dantu is bound to us by native soil and the great enterprise began there; treading that ground ever calls forth feeling, and stirred emotion knows no limit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the third month an edict said: "Dantu is bound to us by native soil and the great enterprise began there; treading that ground ever calls forth feeling, and stirred emotion knows no limit.

sentences.zh: 昔漢章南巡，加恩元氏，況情義二三，有兼曩日。

translations.literal: Formerly when Emperor Zhang of Han toured the south he added favor to the Yuan clan—how much more when affection and righteousness are redoubled, as in days past.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly when Emperor Zhang of Han toured the south he added favor to the Yuan clan—how much more when affection and righteousness are redoubled, as in days past.

sentences.zh: 思播遺澤，酬慰士民。

translations.literal: I think to spread lingering grace and repay and comfort the gentry and people.
translations.idiomatic: I think to spread lingering grace and repay and comfort the gentry and people.

sentences.zh: 其蠲此縣今年租布，五歲刑以下皆悉原遣；

translations.literal: Let this district’s cloth tax for this year be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are entirely pardoned and released;
translations.idiomatic: Let this district’s cloth tax for this year be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are entirely pardoned and released;

sentences.zh: 登城三戰及大將家，隨宜隱卹。

translations.literal: those who fought three battles on the walls and households of great generals—according to circumstances grant hidden condolence.
translations.idiomatic: those who fought three battles on the walls and households of great generals—according to circumstances grant hidden condolence.

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: " On dinghai day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " On dinghai day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，尚書右僕射鄭鮮之卒。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat Zheng Xian-zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Zheng Xian-zhi, Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禁斷夏至日五絲命縷之屬，富陽令諸葛闡之之議也。

translations.literal: On renyin day the use on the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden—this was the proposal of Magistrate of Fuyang Zhuge Kan-zhi.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the use on the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden—this was the proposal of Zhuge Kan-zhi, Magistrate of Fuyang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，以廷尉王徽之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengxu day, Director of the Court of Justice Wang Huizhi was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengxu day, Wang Huizhi, Director of the Court of Justice, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，中護軍王華卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renwu day, General of the Central Guard Wang Hua died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renwu day, Wang Hua, General of the Central Guard, died.

sentences.zh: 京師疾疫，甲午，遣使存問，給醫藥；

translations.literal: An epidemic struck the capital; on jiawu day envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine;
translations.idiomatic: An epidemic struck the capital; on jiawu day envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine;

sentences.zh: 死者若無家屬，賜以棺器。

translations.literal: if the dead had no family, coffins and utensils were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: if the dead had no family, coffins and utensils were bestowed.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On guimao day the first of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the first of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以金紫光祿大夫殷穆為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Grand Master of the Palace with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Yin Mu was made Defender-General.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Yin Mu, Grand Master of the Palace with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, was made Defender-General.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙亥，詔曰：「朕恭承洪業，臨饗四海，風化未弘，治道多昧，求之人事，鑒寐惟憂。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, on yihai day, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and face the realm; customs are not yet spread abroad, the Way of rule has many obscurities, and seeking it in human affairs, I wake and sleep only in worry.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, on yihai day, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and face the realm; customs are not yet spread abroad, the Way of rule has many obscurities, and seeking it in human affairs, I wake and sleep only in worry.

sentences.zh: 加頃陰陽違序，旱疫成患，仰惟災戒，責深在予。

translations.literal: Moreover yin and yang have lately been out of order, drought and plague have become calamities; looking up at the warnings of disaster, the blame lies deep in me.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover yin and yang have lately been out of order, drought and plague have become calamities; looking up at the warnings of disaster, the blame lies deep in me.

sentences.zh: 思所以側身剋念，議獄詳刑，上答天譴，下恤民瘼。

translations.literal: I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on prisons and examine punishments, above to answer Heaven’s reproof, below to soothe the people’s affliction.
translations.idiomatic: I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on prisons and examine punishments, above to answer Heaven’s reproof, below to soothe the people’s affliction.

sentences.zh: 羣后百司，其各獻讜言，指陳得失，勿有所諱。

translations.literal: All you ministers and the hundred offices—each offer loyal words, point out gains and losses, and let nothing be concealed.
translations.idiomatic: All you ministers and the hundred offices—each offer loyal words, point out gains and losses, and let nothing be concealed.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，車駕臨玄武館閱武。

translations.literal: " On jiashen day the imperial carriage attended a military review at the Black Tortoise Hall.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiashen day the imperial carriage attended a military review at the Black Tortoise Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，京邑大火，遣使巡慰賑賜。

translations.literal: On wuzi day a great fire struck the capital; envoys were sent to tour and comfort and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day a great fire struck the capital; envoys were sent to tour and comfort and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，以南蠻校尉蕭摹之為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jihai day, Colonel Director of the Southern Man Xiao Muzhi was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jihai day, Xiao Muzhi, Colonel Director of the Southern Man, was made Inspector of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以始興太守徐豁為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Administrator of Shixing Xu Huo was made Inspector of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Xu Huo, Administrator of Shixing, was made Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，以湘州刺史張邵為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao day, Inspector of Xiang Province Zhang Shao was made Inspector of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao day, Zhang Shao, Inspector of Xiang Province, was made Inspector of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，司徒王弘降為衞將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengxu day, Grand Minister Wang Hong was reduced to Guards General with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu day, Grand Minister Wang Hong was reduced to Guards General with privilege of an office equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 京邑大水，乙卯，[4]遣使檢行賑贍。

translations.literal: A great flood struck the capital; on yimao day [4] envoys were sent to inspect and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: A great flood struck the capital; on yimao day [4] envoys were sent to inspect the damage and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 以江夏內史程道惠為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Administrator of Jiangxia Cheng Daohui was made Inspector of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Daohui, Administrator of Jiangxia, was made Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬戌，特進、左光祿大夫范泰卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on renxu day, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace Fan Tai died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on renxu day, Fan Tai, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen day, the imperial carriage attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen day, the imperial carriage attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸未，以右軍司馬劉德武為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On guiwei day of the intercalary month, Chief Clerk of the Right Army Liu Dewu was made Inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day of the intercalary month, Liu Dewu, Chief Clerk of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，安陸公相周籍之為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Duke of Anlu Xiang Zhou Jizhi was made Inspector of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Zhou Jizhi, Duke of Anlu, was made Inspector of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，左光祿大夫、領軍將軍趙倫之卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengyin day, Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Army Zhao Lunzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengyin day, Zhao Lunzhi, Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Army, died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天竺國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year the state of Tianzhu sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year the state of Tianzhu (India) sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛丑，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year, on xinchou day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year, on xinchou day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以驃騎將軍、荊州刺史彭城王義康為司徒、錄尚書事，領平北將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On guichou day General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was made Grand Minister and Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, retaining the additional post of Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Grand Minister and Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat while retaining Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province.

translations.literal: Textual annotation marker five in the received text.
translations.idiomatic: The received edition inserts commentary marker five at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，立皇子劭為皇太子。

translations.literal: On dingsi day of the third month the imperial son Shao was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day of the third month the imperial son Shao was established as Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大赦天下，賜文武位一等。

translations.literal: On wuwu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; civil and military officials were granted one rank of promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of promotion.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以左衞將軍殷景仁為中領軍。

translations.literal: On xinyou day General of the Left Guard Yin Jingren was made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Yin Jingren, General of the Left Guard, was made General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，以尚書左僕射王敬弘為尚書令，丹陽尹臨川王義慶為尚書左僕射，吏部尚書江夷為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guihai day, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Jinghong was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Administrator of Danyang Prince of Linchuan Yiqing was made Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Director of the Ministry of Personnel Jiang Yi was made Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guihai day, Wang Jinghong was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Administrator of Danyang, was made Left Vice Director; and Jiang Yi, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On renchen day the first of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the first of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以新除尚書令王敬弘為特進、左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On guisi day the newly appointed Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Jinghong was made Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Wang Jinghong, newly appointed Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以撫軍司馬劉道濟為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Chief Clerk of the Pacifying Army Liu Daoji was made Inspector of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Liu Daoji, Chief Clerk of the Pacifying Army, was made Inspector of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，於雍州置馮翊郡。

translations.literal: On yimao day the commandery of Fengyi was established in Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the commandery of Fengyi was established in Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，以尚書左丞孔默之為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiyou day of the seventh month Left Director of the Imperial Secretariat Kong Mozhi was made Inspector of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day of the seventh month Kong Mozhi, Left Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，百濟王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That month the king of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That month the king of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，於秦州置隴西、宋康二郡。

translations.literal: On wuwu day of the ninth month the commanderies of Longxi and Songkang were established in Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the ninth month the commanderies of Longxi and Songkang were established in Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，中領軍殷景仁丁艱去職。

translations.literal: On renshen day of the tenth month General of the Central Army Yin Jingren left office on account of his parent’s mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the tenth month Yin Jingren, General of the Central Army, left office on account of his parent’s mourning.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guiwei day, the state of Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.

translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Zhen Fahu, Pacifying-North Staff Officer, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，索虜滑臺戍棄城走。

sentences.zh: 甲寅，林邑國、訶羅陁國、師子國遣使獻方物。

translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the states of Linyi, Heluotuo, and Shizi (Ceylon) sent envoys presenting local products.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiayin day, Southern Yu Province was abolished and merged into Yu Province.

translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jingling Yixuan, General of the Left, was made Inspector of Xu Province.

translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day a mint was established to cast four-zhu coins.

translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the city of Jinyong was taken by the Northern Barbarians.

translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day of the eleventh month the city of Hulao was again taken by the Northern Barbarians.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣征南大將軍檀道濟北討，右將軍到彥之自滑臺奔退。

translations.literal: On renchen day Campaigning-South Grand General Tan Daoji was sent on a northern punitive campaign; General of the Right Army Dao Yanzhi fled in retreat from Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Tan Daoji, Campaigning-South Grand General, was sent on a northern punitive campaign; Dao Yanzhi, General of the Right Army, fled in retreat from Huatai.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，京邑火，延燒太社北牆。

translations.idiomatic: On yihai day a fire struck the capital, spreading to burn the north wall of the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 兗州刺史竺靈秀有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yan Province Zhu Lingxiu was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Lingxiu, Inspector of Yan Province, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月庚寅，於交州復立珠崖郡。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year, on gengyin day, the commandery of Zhuyai was re-established in Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year, on gengyin day, the commandery of Zhuyai was re-established in Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以左軍將軍申宣為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On guisi day General of the Left Army Shen Xuan was made Inspector of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Shen Xuan, General of the Left Army, was made Inspector of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Campaigning-South Grand General Tan Daoji defeated the Northern Barbarians at Shouzhang in Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Tan Daoji, Campaigning-South Grand General, defeated the Northern Barbarians at Shouzhang in Dongping.

translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the second month Wei Lang, Chief Clerk of the Pacifying North, was made Inspector of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以尚書右僕射江夷為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat Jiang Yi was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Jiang Yi, Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Inspector of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，滑臺為索虜所陷。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Huatai was taken by the Northern Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Huatai was taken by the Northern Barbarians.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，征南大將軍檀道濟引軍還。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Campaigning-South Grand General Tan Daoji led his army back.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Tan Daoji, Campaigning-South Grand General, led his army back.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，青州刺史蕭思話棄城走。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Inspector of Qing Province Xiao Sihua abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Xiao Sihua, Inspector of Qing Province, abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 以太子右衞率劉遵考為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Leader of the Right Guard of the Crown Prince Liu Zunkao was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zunkao, Leader of the Right Guard of the Crown Prince, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On jiashen day of the third month the imperial carriage attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day of the third month the imperial carriage attended to cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「自頃軍役殷興，國用增廣，資儲不給，百度尚繁。

translations.literal: On wushen day an edict said: "Recently military campaigns have been frequent and state expenses have increased; resources and stores do not suffice and the hundred offices are still burdened.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day an edict said: "Recently military campaigns have been frequent and state expenses have increased; resources and stores do not suffice and the hundred offices are still burdened.

sentences.zh: 宜存簡約，以應事實。

translations.literal: Frugality should be preserved to meet actual needs.
translations.idiomatic: Frugality should be preserved to meet actual needs.

sentences.zh: 內外可通共詳思，務令節儉。」

translations.literal: Within and without, all may jointly deliberate in detail and strive to make things economical."
translations.idiomatic: Within and without, all may jointly deliberate in detail and strive to make things economical."

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，以衡陽王師阮萬齡為湘州刺史。

translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the fourth month Master of the Army of Hengyang Wang Shi Wanling was made Inspector of Xiang Province.

translations.literal: On yimao day Rear Army Staff Officer Xu Zunzhi was made Inspector of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Xu Zunzhi, Rear Army Staff Officer, was made Inspector of Yan Province.

translations.idiomatic: On yichou day of the sixth month a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Inspector of Xu Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province, and Ji Han, Chief Clerk of the Grand Minister, was made Inspector of Xu Province.

translations.literal: On gengzi day of the intercalary month an edict said: "Recently agriculture and sericulture have grown slack, wanderers and idlers are many, wasteland is not opened, and supervision and exaction go unheard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day of the intercalary month an edict said: "Recently agriculture and sericulture have grown slack, wanderers and idlers are many, wasteland is not opened, and supervision and exaction go unheard.

translations.literal: When flood and drought come in a season there is at once destitution—if we do not deeply preserve the fundamental task, [9] abundance will have no source.
translations.idiomatic: When flood and drought come in a season there is at once destitution—if we do not deeply preserve the fundamental task, [9] abundance will have no source.

sentences.zh: 郡守賦政方畿，縣宰親民之主，宜思奬訓，導以良規。

translations.literal: The prefects who levy taxes within the borders and the district magistrates who are masters close to the people should think to encourage and instruct, guiding them with good rules.
translations.idiomatic: The prefects who levy taxes within the borders and the district magistrates who are masters close to the people should think to encourage and instruct, guiding them with good rules.

sentences.zh: 咸使肆力，地無遺利，耕蠶樹藝，各盡其力。

translations.literal: Let all exert their strength so the land has no wasted benefit; in plowing, silkworms, trees, and planting each exhaust their effort.
translations.idiomatic: Let all exert their strength so the land has no wasted benefit; in plowing, silkworms, trees, and planting let each exhaust their effort.

sentences.zh: 若有力田殊眾，歲竟條名列上。

translations.literal: If any have outstanding fields and exceptional harvests, at year’s end list them in detail and send them up.
translations.idiomatic: If any have outstanding fields and exceptional harvests, at year’s end list them in detail and send them up.

translations.idiomatic: On yisi day an Attendant Censor inspected prison cases and adjusted corvée levies.

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Liu Daochan, Pacifying-Army Staff Officer, was made Inspector of Yong Province.

translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the eighth month of autumn Prince of Linchuan Yiqing resigned as Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Qin Commandery of Yu Province was assigned to Southern Yan Province.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter Xiang Province was abolished and merged back into Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter Xiang Province was abolished and merged back into Jing Province.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year, on gengxu day, Wang Hong, Guards General, was advanced to Grand Preceptor and given the additional post of Supervisor of the Secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Tan Daoji, Campaigning-South Grand General and Inspector of Jiang Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.

translations.idiomatic: On yihai day of the fourth month Yin Mu, Defender-General, was made Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of the Palace, and Dao Yanzhi, Duke of Jianchang, was made Defender-General.

translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the fifth month Wang Hong, Supervisor of the Secretariat, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, Guards General, and Inspector of Yang Province, died.

translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the sixth month Shen Xuan, Pacifying-Army Staff Officer, was made Inspector of Qing Province.

translations.idiomatic: Ji Province was established by dividing Qing Province.

translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Cui Yin, Staff Officer of the Grand Minister, was made Inspector of Ji Province.

translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-East General, [10] Murong Shiqian was made Pacifying-North General, and Murong Huifa was made General Who Pacifies the Army.

translations.idiomatic: The offices of General of Strong Crossbows and General of Strong Bows were established.

translations.idiomatic: The Di chieftain Yang Nadu, Inspector of Northern Qin Province, was given the additional title of Campaigning-West General.

translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day of the seventh month Wang Zhongde, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province.

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Yin Jingren, General of the Palace Army, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Liu Zhan, Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made General of the Palace Army.

sentences.zh: 九月，妖賊趙廣寇益州，陷沒郡縣，州府討平之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the demonic bandit Zhao Guang raided Yi Province, overran and lost commanderies and districts; the provincial administration suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the demonic bandit Zhao Guang raided Yi Province, overran commanderies and districts, and the provincial administration suppressed and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬子，以少府甄法崇為益州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on renzi day, Director of the Palace Treasury Zhen Fachong was made Inspector of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on renzi day, Zhen Fachong, Director of the Palace Treasury, was made Inspector of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，於廣州立宋康郡。

translations.literal: On guichou day the commandery of Songkang was established in Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the commandery of Songkang was established in Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，以右軍參軍李秀之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu day, Li Xiuzhi, Staff Officer of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu day, Li Xiuzhi, Staff Officer of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立第五皇子紹為廬陵王，江夏王義恭子朗為南豐縣王。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the fifth imperial son Shao was established as Prince of Luling, and Lang, son of Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, as Prince of Nanfeng County.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the fifth imperial son Shao was established as Prince of Luling, and Lang, son of Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, as Prince of Nanfeng County.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月甲寅，竟陵王義宣改封南譙王。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on jiayin day, Prince of Jingling Yixuan was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Nanqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on jiayin day, Prince of Jingling Yixuan was redesignated Prince of Nanqiao.

sentences.zh: 鎮北將軍、徐州刺史王仲德加領兗州刺史，淮南太守段宏為青州刺史。

translations.literal: Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province, was additionally made Inspector of Yan Province; Duan Hong, Administrator of Huainan, was made Inspector of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province, was additionally made Inspector of Yan Province; Duan Hong, Administrator of Huainan, was made Inspector of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 己未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiwei day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: Orphans and the aged alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Orphans and the aged living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 後將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣進號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: Yixin, Prince of Changsha, General of the Rear and Inspector of Yu Province, was advanced in title to General of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Changsha Yixin, General of the Rear and Inspector of Yu Province, was advanced to General of the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，青州刺史段宏加冀州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu day, Duan Hong, Inspector of Qing Province, was additionally made Inspector of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu day, Duan Hong, Inspector of Qing Province, was additionally made Inspector of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 封陽縣侯蕭思話為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: Xiao Sihua, Marquis of Fengyang, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Sihua, Marquis of Fengyang, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 五月，林邑王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the king of Linyi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the king of Linyi (Champa) sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，以前青州刺史韋朗為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yihai day, Wei Lang, former Inspector of Qing Province, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai day, Wei Lang, former Inspector of Qing Province, was made Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 闍婆州訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The state of Heluodan in Campa sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Heluodan in Campa sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，曲赦益、梁、秦三州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu day, a partial amnesty was granted in Yi, Liang, and Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu day, a partial amnesty was granted in Yi, Liang, and Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 於益州立宋寧、宋興二郡。

translations.literal: The commanderies of Songning and Songxing were established in Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies of Songning and Songxing were established in Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，於青州立太原郡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingchou day, Taiyuan Commandery was established in Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou day, Taiyuan Commandery was established in Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，護軍將軍到彥之卒。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Tao Yanzhi, General Who Protects the Army, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Tao Yanzhi, General Who Protects the Army, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，氐楊難當寇漢川。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter the Di chieftain Yang Nadu raided Hanzhuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter the Di chieftain Yang Nadu raided Hanzhuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，梁州刺史甄法護棄城走，難當據有梁州。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Zhen Fahu, Inspector of Liang Province, abandoned the city and fled; Nadu seized Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Zhen Fahu, Inspector of Liang Province, abandoned the city and fled, and Nadu took possession of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月，亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山，[13]州郡討平之。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the eleventh year the outlaw Ma Daxuan and his band of several hundred men raided Mount Tai; [13] the province and commanderies suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the eleventh year the outlaw Ma Daxuan and his band of several hundred men raided Mount Tai; [13] the province and commanderies suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，以交阯太守李耽之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guiyou day, Li Danzhi, Administrator of Jiaozhi, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiyou day, Li Danzhi, Administrator of Jiaozhi, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，梁、秦二州刺史蕭思話破氐楊難當，梁州平。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Xiao Sihua, Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nadu, and Liang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Xiao Sihua, Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nadu, and Liang Province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，曲赦梁、南秦二州劍閣北。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingmao day, a partial amnesty was granted in Liang and Southern Qin provinces north of Jian’ge Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingmao day, a partial amnesty was granted in Liang and Southern Qin provinces north of Jian’ge Pass.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以大沮渠茂虔為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Juqu Maoqian of Northern Liang was made Campaigning-West Grand General and Inspector of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Juqu Maoqian of Northern Liang was made Campaigning-West Grand General and Inspector of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，京邑大水。

translations.literal: That month the capital suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month the capital suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，省魏郡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingwei day, Wei Commandery was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingwei day, Wei Commandery was abolished.

sentences.zh: 是歲，林邑國、扶南國、訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year Linyi, Funan, and Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year Linyi, Funan, and Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月辛酉，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twelfth year, on xinyou day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twelfth year, on xinyou day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封黃龍國主馮弘為燕王。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Feng Hong, ruler of the Yellow Dragon state, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Feng Hong, ruler of the Yellow Dragon state, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，[14]尚書僕射殷景仁加中護軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou day, [14] Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was additionally made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou day, [14] Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was additionally made General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「周宗以寧，實由多士，漢室之隆，亦資得人。

translations.literal: On bingchen day an edict said: "The house of Zhou attained tranquility through its many officers; the rise of the Han house likewise relied on obtaining capable men.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict said: "The house of Zhou attained peace through its many officers; the rise of the Han dynasty likewise depended on finding capable men.

sentences.zh: 朕寐寤樂賢，為日已久，而則哲難階，明揚莫効。

translations.literal: Ever waking and sleeping I delight in worthies—it has been so for many days—yet sage discernment is hard to attain and bright promotion has had no effect.
translations.idiomatic: I have long dreamed and waked with joy in worthy men, yet sage discernment remains hard to reach and bright promotion has borne no fruit.

sentences.zh: 用令遺才在野，管庫虛朝，永懷前載，慚德深矣。

translations.literal: Thus outstanding talent remains in the wilds and the storehouses stand empty at court; ever recalling the records of old, my shame in virtue runs deep.
translations.idiomatic: Outstanding talent still wanders beyond office, and the court’s storehouses stand empty; thinking forever on the records of old, I am deeply ashamed of my own virtue.

sentences.zh: 夫舉爾所知，宣尼之篤訓，貢士任官，先代之成准。

translations.literal: To raise those whom you know is the Kongzi’s earnest teaching; to present scholars and assign them office is the established standard of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: To recommend those you know is Confucius’s earnest teaching; presenting scholars and appointing them to office is the settled standard of former ages.

sentences.zh: 便可宣敕內外，各有薦舉。

translations.literal: Let an edict now be proclaimed within and without, that each may make recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: Let an edict now be proclaimed within and without, and let each office make recommendations.

sentences.zh: 當依方銓引，以觀厥用。

translations.literal: They shall be weighed and promoted by measure, to observe what use they can serve."
translations.idiomatic: They shall be weighed and advanced by their measure, that we may see what use they can serve."

sentences.zh: 」是夜，京都地震。

translations.literal: That night the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That night the capital was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月，丹陽、淮南、吳興、義興大水，京邑乘船。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Danyang, Huainan, Wuxing, and Yixing suffered great flooding; in the capital people traveled by boat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Danyang, Huainan, Wuxing, and Yixing suffered severe flooding, and in the capital people went about by boat.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以徐豫南兗三州、會稽宣城二郡米數百萬斛賜五郡遭水民。

translations.literal: On jiyou day several million hu of grain from Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan provinces and from Kuaiji and Xuancheng commanderies were granted to the people of the five flood-stricken commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day several million hu of grain from Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan provinces and from Kuaiji and Xuancheng commanderies were distributed to the people of the five flood-stricken commanderies.

sentences.zh: 是月，斷酒。

translations.literal: That month the sale of wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: That month the sale of wine was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 師子國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The Lion Country sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The Lion Country (Sri Lanka) sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，[15]闍婆娑達國、扶南國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou day, [15] the states of Campasataka and Funan both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou day, [15] the states of Campasataka and Funan both sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，於益州立南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renshen day, the three commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established in Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renshen day, the three commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established in Yi Province.

sentences.zh: [16]乙亥，原遭水郡諸逋負。

translations.literal: [16] On yihai day all overdue obligations in the flood-stricken commanderies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: [16] On yihai day all overdue obligations in the flood-stricken commanderies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月，蜀郡賊張尋為寇。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the bandit Zhang Xun of Shu Commandery rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the bandit Zhang Xun of Shu Commandery rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，以右軍行參軍苟道覆為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter Qu Daofu, Acting Staff Officer of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter Qu Daofu, Acting Staff Officer of the Right Army, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月癸丑，上有疾，不朝會。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the thirteenth year, on guichou day, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the thirteenth year, on guichou day, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court audience.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，司空、江州刺史檀道濟有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiwei day, Tan Daoji, Minister of Works and Inspector of Jiang Province, was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiwei day, Tan Daoji, Minister of Works and Inspector of Jiang Province, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 以中軍將軍南譙王義宣為鎮南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao and General of the Central Army, was made Pacifying-South General and Inspector of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General of the Central Army, was made Pacifying-South General and Inspector of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊辰，鎮北將軍、徐兗二州刺史王仲德進號鎮北大將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on wuchen day, Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was advanced in title to Pacifying-North Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wuchen day, Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was advanced to Pacifying-North Grand General.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以征北司馬王方俳為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Wang Fangpai, Staff Officer of the Campaigning-North General, was made Inspector of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Wang Fangpai, Staff Officer of the Campaigning-North General, was made Inspector of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 六月，高麗國、武都王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Goguryeo and the King of Wudu sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Goguryeo and the King of Wudu sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，尚書僕射、中護軍殷景仁改為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengyin day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General of the Central Army, was changed to General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengyin day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General of the Central Army, was redesignated General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，立第二皇子濬為始興王，第三皇子駿為武陵王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guichou day, the second imperial son Jun was established as Prince of Shixing, and the third imperial son Jun as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guichou day, the second imperial son Jun was established as Prince of Shixing, and the third imperial son Jun as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月辛卯，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourteenth year, on xinmao day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fourteenth year, on xinmao day, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 文武賜位一等；

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted one rank of promotion;
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were promoted one rank;

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: orphans and the aged alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: orphans and the aged living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，以步兵校尉劉真道為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi day, Liu Zhendao, Colonel of Footsoldiers, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi day, Liu Zhendao, Colonel of Footsoldiers, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

translations.idiomatic: The received edition inserts commentary marker seventeen at this point in the narrative.

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingwei day, Zhou Jizhi, General Who Assists the State, was made Inspector of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingwei day, Zhou Jizhi, General Who Assists the State, was made Inspector of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊午，以尚書金部郎中徐森之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on wuwu day, Xu Senzhi, Gentleman of the Gold Section in the Imperial Secretariat, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on wuwu day, Xu Senzhi, Gentleman of the Gold Section in the Imperial Secretariat, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月辛酉，停賀雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on xinyou day, the rite of congratulating on snow was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on xinyou day, the rite of congratulating on snow was suspended.

sentences.zh: 河南國、河西王、訶羅單國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The states of Henan, the King of Hexi, and Heluodan all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The states of Henan, the King of Hexi, and Heluodan all sent envoys presenting local products.
