translations.idiomatic: The received edition inserts commentary marker eighteen at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 十五年春二月丁未，以平東將軍吐谷渾慕容延為鎮西將軍、秦河二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the fifteenth year, on dingwei day, Murong Yan of Tuyuhun, General Who Pacifies the East, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Qin and He provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the fifteenth year, on dingwei day, Murong Yan of Tuyuhun, General Who Pacifies the East, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Qin and He provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，燕王弘遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiachen day, Prince of Yan Hong sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiachen day, Prince of Yan Hong sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: [19]立皇太子妃殷氏，賜王公以下各有差。

translations.literal: [19] The consort of the Crown Prince of the Yin clan was established, and kings, dukes, and those below were each granted gifts according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: [19] The Crown Prince’s consort of the Yin clan was installed, and kings, dukes, and officials below them were each granted gifts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以倭國王珍為安東將軍。

translations.literal: On jisi day King Zhen of Wa was made Pacifying-East General.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day King Zhen of Wa (Japan) was made Pacifying-East General.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，特進、右光祿大夫殷穆卒。

translations.literal: On jichou day Yin Mu, Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of Splendid Virtue, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Yin Mu, Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of Splendid Virtue, died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鎮北大將軍、徐州刺史王仲德卒。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North Grand General and Inspector of Xu Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Wang Zhongde, Pacifying-North Grand General and Inspector of Xu Province, died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以右衞將軍劉遵考為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen day Liu Zunkao, General of the Right Guard, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Liu Zunkao, General of the Right Guard, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，地震。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei day, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei day, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以陳、南頓二郡太守徐循為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Xu Xun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun commanderies, was made Inspector of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xu Xun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun commanderies, was made Inspector of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，以左衞將軍趙伯符為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinchou day, Zhao Bofu, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinchou day, Zhao Bofu, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以始興內史陸徽為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Lu Hui, Administrator of Shixing, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Lu Hui, Administrator of Shixing, was made Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以兗州刺史王方俳為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Wang Fangpai, Inspector of Yan Province, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Wang Fangpai, Inspector of Yan Province, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南國、高麗國、倭國、扶南國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year the King of Wudu, the state of Henan, Goguryeo, Wa, Funan, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year the King of Wudu, the state of Henan, Goguryeo, Wa (Japan), Funan, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月戊寅，車駕於北郊閱武。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixteenth year, on wuyin day, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the sixteenth year, on wuyin day, the Emperor reviewed troops at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史彭城王義康進位大將軍，領司徒，餘如故。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province, was advanced in rank to Grand General; he continued as Minister over the Masses, and the rest of his offices remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province, was advanced to Grand General; he remained Minister over the Masses, and his other offices were unchanged.

sentences.zh: 征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭進位司空，刺史如故。

translations.literal: Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, Campaigning-North General, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was advanced in rank to Minister of Works; his inspectorship remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Campaigning-North General, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was advanced to Minister of Works; his inspectorship was unchanged.

sentences.zh: 特進、左光祿大夫王敬弘開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Wang Jinghong, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of Splendid Virtue, was given the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jinghong, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of Splendid Virtue, received the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，復分荊州置湘州。

translations.literal: On guisi day Jing Province was again divided to establish Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Jing Province was again divided to establish Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，以南徐州刺史衡陽王義季為安西將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jihai day, Yiji, Prince of Hengyang and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai day, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以始興王濬為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Prince of Shixing Jun was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Prince of Shixing Jun was made Inspector of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，割梁州之巴西梓潼南宕渠南漢中、南秦州之南安懷寧凡六郡，[20]屬益州。

translations.literal: On guihai day the six commanderies of Baxi, Zitong, Southern Dangqu, and Southern Hanzhong from Liang Province and Nan’an and Huaining from Southern Qin Province were severed [20] and placed under Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the six commanderies of Baxi, Zitong, Southern Dangqu, and Southern Hanzhong from Liang Province and Nan’an and Huaining from Southern Qin Province were detached [20] and assigned to Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 分長沙江夏郡立巴陵郡，屬湘州。

translations.literal: Baling Commandery was established from Changsha and Jiangxia commanderies and placed under Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Baling Commandery was carved out of Changsha and Jiangxia commanderies and placed under Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史南譙王義宣為征北將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi day, Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, Pacifying-South General and Inspector of Jiang Province, was made Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi day, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, Pacifying-South General and Inspector of Jiang Province, was made Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 平西將軍臨川王義慶為衞將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan and Pacifying-West General, was made General of the Guard and Inspector of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Pacifying-West General, was made General of the Guard and Inspector of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，隴西吐谷渾慕容延改封河南王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiyou day, Murong Yan of Longxi Tuyuhun was changed in enfeoffment to King of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiyou day, Murong Yan of Longxi Tuyuhun was redesignated King of Henan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以吐谷渾拾寅為平西將軍，吐谷渾繁暱為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On guichou day Murong Shibin of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-West General, and Fan Ni of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Murong Shibin of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-West General, and Fan Ni of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-Army General.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚子，立第四皇子鑠為南平王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on gengzi day, the fourth imperial son Shuo was established as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on gengzi day, the fourth imperial son Shuo was established as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，鎮軍將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣薨。

translations.literal: On yiwei day of the intercalary month Yixin, Prince of Changsha, General of the Army and Inspector of Yu Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day of the intercalary month Prince of Changsha Yixin, General of the Army and Inspector of Yu Province, died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，復分豫州之淮南為南豫州。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Huainan was again divided from Yu Province to establish Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Huainan was again severed from Yu Province to establish Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以左衞將軍劉遵考為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On guimao day Liu Zunkao, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Liu Zunkao, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以湘州刺史始興王濬為南豫州刺史，武陵王駿為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen day Prince of Shixing Jun, Inspector of Xiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province, and Prince of Wuling Jun was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Prince of Shixing Jun, Inspector of Xiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province, and Prince of Wuling Jun was made Inspector of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月乙亥，皇太子冠，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on yihai day, the Crown Prince underwent the capping ceremony and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on yihai day, the Crown Prince underwent the capping ceremony and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南王、林邑國、高麗國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, Linyi, and Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, Linyi, and Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 十七年夏四月戊午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the seventeenth year, on wuwu day the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer of the seventeenth year, on wuwu day the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，領軍將軍劉湛母憂去職。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guisi day, Liu Zhan, General of the Army of the Palace Guard, left office on account of his mother’s mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guisi day, Liu Zhan, General of the Army of the Palace Guard, left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，以征虜諮議參軍杜驥為青州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin day, Du Ji, Staff Officer for Consultation in the Office for Campaigning Against Barbarians, was made Inspector of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin day, Du Ji, Staff Officer for Consultation in the Office for Campaigning Against Barbarians, was made Inspector of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 壬子，皇后袁氏崩。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Empress Yuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Empress Yuan died.

sentences.zh: 八月，徐、兗、青、冀四州大水，己未，遣使檢行賑卹。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered great floods; on jiwei day envoys were sent to inspect and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered great floods; on jiwei day envoys were sent to inspect the damage and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，葬元皇后於長寧陵。

translations.literal: On renzi day of the ninth month, the Founding Empress was buried at Everlasting Peace Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day of the ninth month, the Founding Empress was buried at Everlasting Peace Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，前丹陽尹劉湛有罪，及同黨伏誅。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu day, Liu Zhan, former Director of Danyang, was guilty and executed together with his clique.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu day, Liu Zhan, former Director of Danyang, was found guilty and executed together with his clique.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，文武賜爵一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍、領司徒、錄尚書、揚州刺史彭城王義康為江州刺史，大將軍如故。

translations.literal: Grand General, concurrent Minister over the Masses, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was made Inspector of Jiang Province, retaining Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, concurrent Minister over the Masses, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, and Inspector of Yang Province, was made Inspector of Jiang Province while retaining Grand General.

sentences.zh: 以司空、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為司徒、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Yan Province Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was made Minister over the Masses and Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Minister over the Masses and Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，衞將軍臨川王義慶以本號為南兗州刺史，尚書僕射、護軍將軍殷景仁為揚州刺史，僕射如故。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Guards General Prince of Linchuan Yiqing was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province under his existing title; Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General Who Protects the Army Yin Jingren was made Inspector of Yang Province, retaining Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Guards General, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province under his existing title; Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General Who Protects the Army, was made Inspector of Yang Province while retaining Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，以尚書劉義融為領軍將軍，祕書監徐湛之為中護軍。

translations.literal: On bingxu day of the eleventh month, Director in the Imperial Secretariat Liu Yirong was made General Who Leads the Army; Supervisor of the Secretariat Xu Zhanzhi was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the eleventh month, Liu Yirong, Director in the Imperial Secretariat, was made General Who Leads the Army, and Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Secretariat, was made General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「前所給揚、南徐二州百姓田糧種子，兗、兩豫、青、徐諸州比年所寬租穀應督入者，悉除半。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, an edict said: "The grain and seed for fields previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain from Yan, the two Yu provinces, Qing, and Xu that in recent years was reduced and should be collected—all are remitted by half.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, an edict said: "The grain and seed for fields previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain from Yan, the two Yu provinces, Qing, and Xu that in recent years was reduced and should be collected—all are remitted by half.

sentences.zh: 今年有不收處，[21]都原之。

translations.literal: Where there is no harvest this year, [21] remit entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Where there is no harvest this year, [21] remit the obligation entirely.

sentences.zh: 凡諸逋債，優量申減。

translations.literal: All overdue debts are to be generously assessed and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: All overdue debts are to be generously assessed and reduced.

sentences.zh: 又州郡估稅，所在市調，多有煩刻。

translations.literal: Also, market taxes in provinces and commanderies and local market levies are in many places burdensome and harsh.
translations.idiomatic: Market taxes in provinces and commanderies and local market levies, too, are in many places burdensome and harsh.

sentences.zh: 山澤之利，猶或禁斷；

translations.literal: Profits from mountains and marshes are still sometimes prohibited;
translations.idiomatic: Profits from mountains and marshes are still sometimes prohibited;

sentences.zh: 役召之品，遂及稚弱。

translations.literal: categories of corvée summons even reach the young and weak.
translations.idiomatic: categories of corvée summons even reach the young and weak.

sentences.zh: 諸如此比，傷治害民。

translations.literal: All such matters harm governance and injure the people.
translations.idiomatic: Matters such as these harm governance and injure the people.

sentences.zh: 自今咸依法令，務盡優允。

translations.literal: From now on all shall follow the laws and statutes, striving for utmost generosity and accommodation.
translations.idiomatic: From now on all shall follow the laws and statutes and strive for utmost generosity and accommodation.

sentences.zh: 如有不便，即依事別言，不得苟趣一時，以乖隱卹之旨。

translations.literal: If anything is inconvenient, report separately according to the matter; you must not hasten for the moment and thereby violate the intent of hidden compassion.
translations.idiomatic: If anything is inconvenient, report it separately on its merits; you must not chase the moment and thereby betray the intent of hidden compassion.

sentences.zh: 主者明加宣下，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: The responsible offices shall clearly proclaim this downward, to voice my intent."
translations.idiomatic: Let the responsible offices clearly proclaim this throughout the realm, to voice my intent."

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，尚書僕射、揚州刺史殷景仁卒。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Inspector of Yang Province Yin Jingren died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Inspector of Yang Province, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On guihai day of the twelfth month, Special Grand Master Wang Qiu was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the twelfth month, Wang Qiu, Special Grand Master, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: [22]戊辰，以南豫州刺史始興王濬為揚州刺史，湘州刺史武陵王駿為南豫州刺史，南平王鑠為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: [22] On wuchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was made Inspector of Yang Province; Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Xiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province; and Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: [22] On wuchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was made Inspector of Yang Province; Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Xiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yu Province; and Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Inspector of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南王、百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, and Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, and Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 十八年春二月乙卯，以豫章太守庾登之為江州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the eighteenth year, on yimao day, Yu Dengzhi, Administrator of Yuzhang, was made Inspector of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the eighteenth year, on yimao day, Yu Dengzhi, Administrator of Yuzhang, was made Inspector of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午，[23]衞將軍南兗州刺史臨川王義慶、征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on renwu day, [23] Guards General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province Prince of Linchuan Yiqing and Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan were both given offices equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on renwu day, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Guards General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, were both given offices equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，於交州置宋熙郡。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Songxi Commandery was established in Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Songxi Commandery was established in Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，沔水泛溢。

translations.literal: That month the Han River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Han River overflowed its banks.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，遣使巡行賑贍。

translations.literal: On wuchen day of the sixth month, envoys were sent to tour and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day of the sixth month, envoys were sent to tour the regions and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，領軍將軍劉義融卒。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, General Who Leads the Army Liu Yirong died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Liu Yirong, General Who Leads the Army, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，以徐、兗二州刺史趙伯符為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On xushu day of the seventh month of autumn, Zhao Bofu, Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xushu day of the seventh month of autumn, Zhao Bofu, Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was made General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，以巴東、建平二郡太守臧質為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinhai day, Zang Zhi, Administrator of Badong and Jianping, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinhai day, Zang Zhi, Administrator of Badong and Jianping, was made Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，省南徐州之南燕、濮陽、南廣平郡。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，尚書僕射王球卒。

translations.literal: On wuzi day of the eleventh month, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Qiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the eleventh month, Wang Qiu, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: [24]己亥，以丹陽尹孟顗為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: [24] On jihai day, Meng Yi, Director of Danyang, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: [24] On jihai day, Meng Yi, Director of Danyang, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 氐楊難當又寇漢川。

translations.literal: The Di chieftain Yang Nadu again raided Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: The Di chieftain Yang Nadu again raided Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，遣龍驤將軍裴方明與梁、秦二州刺史劉真道討之。

translations.literal: On guihai day of the twelfth month, Dragon Cavalry General Pei Fangming and Liu Zhendao, Inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, were sent to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the twelfth month, Pei Fangming, Dragon Cavalry General, and Liu Zhendao, Inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, were sent to attack him.

sentences.zh: 是月，[25]晉寧太守爨松子反叛，寧州刺史徐循討平之。

translations.literal: That month, [25] Cuan Songzi, Administrator of Jinning, rebelled; Xu Xun, Inspector of Ning Province, suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: That month, [25] Cuan Songzi, Administrator of Jinning, rebelled; Xu Xun, Inspector of Ning Province, suppressed and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，肅特國、高麗國、蘇靡黎國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year the states of Sute, Goguryeo, Sumoli, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year the states of Sute, Goguryeo, Sumoli, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月乙巳，詔曰：「夫所因者本，聖哲之遠教；

translations.literal: In the first month of the nineteenth year, on yisi day, an edict said: "What one relies upon is the root—that is the far-reaching teaching of sages;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the nineteenth year, on yisi day, an edict said: "What one relies upon is the root—that is the far-reaching teaching of sages;

sentences.zh: 本立化成，斆學之為貴。

translations.literal: when the root is established, transformation takes form, and earnest study is what is prized.
translations.idiomatic: when the root is established, transformation takes form, and earnest study is what is prized.

sentences.zh: 故詔以三德，崇以四術，用能納諸義方，致之軌度。

translations.literal: Therefore the three virtues were proclaimed in edicts and the four arts were exalted, whereby one could receive all into the path of righteousness and bring them to the measure.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the three virtues were proclaimed in edicts and the four arts were exalted, whereby one could receive all into the path of righteousness and bring them to the measure.

sentences.zh: 盛王聖世，[26]咸必由之。

translations.literal: In flourishing kingship and sage eras, [26] all necessarily pass through this.
translations.idiomatic: In ages of flourishing kingship and sage rule, [26] all necessarily pass through this.

sentences.zh: 永初受命，憲章弘遠，將陶鈞庶品，混一殊風，有詔典司，大啟庠序，而頻遘屯夷，未及修建。

There were edicts to the responsible offices to broadly open schools, but repeatedly We encountered hardships and could not complete the construction.

Edicts went to the responsible offices to open schools broadly, yet repeatedly We encountered hardships and could not complete the work.

sentences.zh: 永瞻前猷，思敷鴻烈。

translations.literal: Ever gazing at the former plan, We think to spread the great achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Ever gazing at the former plan, We think to spread the great achievement.

sentences.zh: 今方隅乂寧，戎夏慕嚮，廣訓冑子，實維時務。

translations.literal: Now the four quarters are at peace, barbarians and Chinese alike look to Us in admiration; broadly to instruct the sons of officers is truly the business of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Now the four quarters are at peace, and barbarians and Chinese alike look to Us in admiration; broadly to instruct the sons of officers is truly the business of the age.

sentences.zh: 便可式遵成規，闡揚景業。」

translations.literal: Let there at once be patterned observance of the established regulations and spreading illumination of the splendid enterprise."
translations.idiomatic: Let there at once be patterned observance of the established regulations and the spreading illumination of the splendid enterprise."

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，以久疾愈，始奉礿祠，[27]大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiaxu day, as the long illness had healed, he first performed the yue sacrifice, [27] and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiaxu day, as his long illness had healed, he first performed the yue sacrifice, [27] and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，梁秦二州刺史劉真道、龍驤將軍裴方明破氐楊難當，仇池平。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengyin day, Liu Zhendao, Inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, and Dragon Cavalry General Pei Fangming defeated the Di Yang Nadu, and Chouchi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin day, Liu Zhendao, Inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, and Pei Fangming, Dragon Cavalry General, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nadu, and Chouchi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 閏月，京邑雨水；

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, rain fell in the capital;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, rain fell in the capital;

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣使巡行賑卹。

translations.literal: on dingsi day, envoys were sent to tour and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: on dingsi day, envoys were sent to tour the regions and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，以大沮渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。

translations.literal: On renwu day of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was made Campaigning-West Grand General and Inspector of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was made Campaigning-West Grand General and Inspector of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以梁、秦二州刺史劉真道為雍州刺史，龍驤將軍裴方明為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Liu Zhendao, Inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, was made Inspector of Yong Province; Pei Fangming, Dragon Cavalry General, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Liu Zhendao, Inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, was made Inspector of Yong Province; Pei Fangming, Dragon Cavalry General, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲戌晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: At the end of jiaxu day there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of jiaxu day there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiashen day of the tenth month of winter, Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day of the tenth month of winter, Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以晉寧太守周萬歲為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Zhou Wansui, Administrator of Jinning, was made Inspector of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Zhou Wansui, Administrator of Jinning, was made Inspector of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，詔曰：「冑子始集，學業方興。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, an edict said: "The sons of officers are beginning to assemble and studies are rising.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, an edict said: "The sons of officers are beginning to assemble and studies are rising.

sentences.zh: 自微言泯絕，逝將千祀，感事思人，意有慨然。

translations.literal: Since subtle teachings were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by the matter, We think of those men and Our feelings are stirred with emotion.
translations.idiomatic: Since subtle teachings were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by the matter, We think of those men and Our feelings are stirred with emotion.

sentences.zh: 奉聖之胤，可速議繼襲。

translations.literal: The descendant of the Sage of Manifestation may quickly deliberate succession.
translations.idiomatic: The descendant of the Sage of Manifestation may quickly deliberate his succession.

sentences.zh: 於先廟地，特為營造，依舊給祠置令，四時饗祀。

translations.literal: On ground by the former temple specially build; according to the old practice grant sacrificers and set directors, with offerings in the four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: On ground by the former temple build specially; according to the old practice grant sacrificers and set directors, with offerings in the four seasons.

sentences.zh: 闕里往經寇亂，黌校殘毀，并下魯郡修復學舍，採召生徒。

translations.literal: The Que village quarter in the past suffered bandit turmoil and the school halls were ruined; also order Lu Commandery to repair the school buildings and gather students.
translations.idiomatic: The Que village quarter in the past suffered bandit turmoil and the school halls were ruined; also order Lu Commandery to repair the school buildings and gather students.

sentences.zh: 昔之賢哲及一介之善，猶或衞其丘壟，禁其芻牧，況尼父德表生民，功被百代，而墳塋荒蕪，荊棘弗翦。

translations.literal: Sages of old and a single act of goodness—even they would guard their hillock-graves and forbid grazing and fuel-gathering; how much more does the Teacher, whose virtue is the measure for living men and whose merit covers a hundred generations—yet his grave yard lies waste and brambles are not cut.
translations.idiomatic: Sages of old and a single act of goodness—even they would guard their hillock-graves and forbid grazing and fuel-gathering; how much more the Teacher, whose virtue is the measure for living men and whose merit covers a hundred generations—yet his grave yard lies waste and brambles are not cut.

sentences.zh: 可蠲墓側數戶，以掌洒掃。

translations.literal: It is ordered to exempt several households beside the tomb to attend to sweeping and sprinkling.
translations.idiomatic: Let several households beside the tomb be exempted to attend to sweeping and sprinkling.

sentences.zh: 」魯郡上民孔景等五戶居近孔子墓側，蠲其課役，供給洒掃，并種松栢六百株。

translations.literal: The leading households of Lu Commandery, Kong Jing and five others living near Confucius's tomb, were exempted from tax and corvée and supplied for sweeping, and also planted six hundred pine and cypress trees.
translations.idiomatic: The leading households of Lu Commandery, Kong Jing and five others living near Confucius's tomb, were exempted from tax and corvée and supplied for sweeping, and also planted six hundred pine and cypress trees.

sentences.zh: 是歲，婆皇國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year the state of Bohuang sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year the state of Bohuang sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月，於臺城東西開萬春、千秋二門。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, at the east and west of the palace city the Everlasting Spring and Thousand Autumns gates were opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, at the east and west of the palace city the Everlasting Spring and Thousand Autumns gates were opened.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，江州刺史庾登之為中護軍。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day of the second month, Yu Dengzhi, Inspector of Jiang Province, was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the second month, Yu Dengzhi, Inspector of Jiang Province, was made General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 庚申，[28]以廬陵王紹為江州刺史。

translations.literal: [28] On gengshen day, Prince of Luling Shao was made Inspector of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: [28] On gengshen day, Prince of Luling Shao was made Inspector of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 仇池為索虜所沒。

translations.literal: Chouchi was lost to the Suolu.
translations.idiomatic: Chouchi was lost to the Suolu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，車駕於白下閱武。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Baixia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Baixia.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，安西將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季進號征西大將軍。

translations.literal: On xinhai day of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Jing Province, was advanced to Campaigning-West Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Jing Province, was advanced to Campaigning-West Grand General.

sentences.zh: 以巴西、梓潼二郡太守申坦為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: Shen Tan, Administrator of Bazhou and Zitong, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Tan, Administrator of Bazhou and Zitong, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiawu day, the sixth imperial son Dan was established as Prince of Guangling.

translations.idiomatic: On guichou day of the fifth month, Yu Dengzhi, General Who Protects the Army, died.

translations.idiomatic: On guichou day of the seventh month, Yang Wende was made Campaigning-West General and Inspector of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as King of Wudu.

translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Xiao Sihua, Southern Man Commandant, was made Inspector of Yong Province.

translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Liu Zhendao, former Inspector of Yong Province, and Pei Fangming, Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, were found guilty, imprisoned, and executed.

translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day of the eighth month, Tao Minzu, Director of the Court of Justice, was made Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚午，以始興內史檀和之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengwu day of the twelfth month of winter, Tan Hezhi, Administrative Supervisor of Shixing, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day of the twelfth month of winter, Tan Hezhi, Administrative Supervisor of Shixing, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.

translations.literal: On renwu day, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root; the people take grain as their heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root; the people take grain as their heaven.

sentences.zh: 故一夫輟稼，饑者必及。

translations.literal: If a single man neglects the harvest, hunger must reach others.
translations.idiomatic: If a single man neglects the harvest, hunger must reach others.

sentences.zh: 倉廩既實，禮節以興。

translations.literal: When granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.
translations.idiomatic: When granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.

sentences.zh: 自頃在所貧罄，家無宿積。

translations.literal: Recently everywhere is destitute and exhausted, and homes have no stored surplus.
translations.idiomatic: Recently everywhere is destitute and exhausted, and homes have no stored surplus.

sentences.zh: 賦役暫偏，則人懷愁墊；

translations.literal: When tax and corvée press unevenly, people bear grief and ruin;
translations.idiomatic: When tax and corvée press unevenly, people bear grief and ruin;

sentences.zh: 歲或不稔，而病乏比室。

translations.literal: in years when the harvest fails, illness and want fill house after house.
translations.idiomatic: in years when the harvest fails, illness and want fill house after house.

translations.literal: This is truly because governing virtue has not won trust, bringing these ills;
translations.idiomatic: This is truly because governing virtue has not won trust, bringing these ills;

sentences.zh: 抑亦耕桑未廣，地利多遺。

translations.literal: yet also because farming and sericulture are not widespread and much of the land's benefit lies unused.
translations.idiomatic: yet also because farming and sericulture are not widespread and much of the land's benefit lies unused.

sentences.zh: 宰守微化導之方，萌庶忘勤分之義。

translations.literal: The prefects and magistrates are slight in methods of mild transformation, and the people forget the duty of diligent division of labor.
translations.idiomatic: The prefects and magistrates are slight in methods of mild transformation, and the people forget the duty of diligent division of labor.

sentences.zh: 永言弘濟，明發載懷。

translations.literal: Ever speaking of broad relief, at dawn Our thoughts are burdened.
translations.idiomatic: Ever speaking of broad relief, at dawn Our thoughts are burdened.

sentences.zh: 雖制令亟下，終莫懲勸，而坐望滋殖，庸可致乎。

translations.literal: Though regulations are issued repeatedly, in the end none are moved to reform—and to sit and hope for increase, how can that be attained?
translations.idiomatic: Though regulations are issued repeatedly, in the end none are moved to reform—and to sit and hope for increase, how can that be attained?

sentences.zh: 有司其班宣舊條，務盡敦課。

translations.literal: Let the responsible offices proclaim the old articles and strive for utmost earnest instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Let the responsible offices proclaim the old articles and strive for utmost earnest instruction.

sentences.zh: 遊食之徒，咸令附業，考覈勤惰，行其誅賞，觀察能殿，嚴加黜陟。

translations.literal: Wanderers and idlers are all ordered to attach to livelihoods; examine diligence and sloth and apply rewards and punishments; observe capacity and on that basis strictly demote or promote.
translations.idiomatic: Wanderers and idlers are all ordered to attach to livelihoods; examine diligence and sloth and apply rewards and punishments; observe capacity and on that basis strictly demote or promote.

sentences.zh: 古者躬耕帝籍，敬供粢盛，仰瞻前王，思遵令典。

translations.literal: In antiquity the ruler himself plowed the imperial fields and reverently supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, We think to follow the established canon.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the ruler himself plowed the imperial fields and reverently supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, We think to follow the established canon.

sentences.zh: 便可量處千畝，考卜元辰。

translations.literal: Let a thousand mu be measured out and the primary day divined.
translations.idiomatic: Let a thousand mu be measured out and the primary day divined.

sentences.zh: 朕當親率百辟，致禮郊甸，庶幾誠素，將被斯民。」

translations.literal: I shall personally lead the hundred officials to perform rites at the suburban fields, that sincerity and simplicity may spread to the people."
translations.idiomatic: I shall personally lead the hundred officials to perform rites at the suburban fields, that sincerity and simplicity may spread to the people."

sentences.zh: 是歲，河西國、高麗國、百濟國、倭國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: That year Hexi, Goguryeo, Baekje, and Wa all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hexi, Goguryeo, Baekje, and Wa (Japan) all sent envoys presenting local products.

translations.literal: That year provinces and commanderies suffered flood and drought damage to crops; the people suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year provinces and commanderies suffered flood and drought damage to crops, and the people suffered great famine.

sentences.zh: 遣使開倉賑卹，給賜糧種。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to open granaries for relief and grant grain and seed.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to open granaries for relief and grant grain and seed.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月己亥，南徐、南豫州、揚州之浙江西，[29]並禁酒。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-first year, on jihai day, Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and west of the Qiantang River in Yang Province—[29] wine was prohibited throughout.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-first year, on jihai day, Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and west of the Qiantang River in Yang Province—[29] the sale of wine was prohibited throughout.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 諸逋債在十九年以前，一切原除。

translations.literal: All overdue debts from before the nineteenth year are entirely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All overdue debts dating from before the nineteenth year are entirely remitted.

sentences.zh: 去歲失收者，疇量申減。

translations.literal: For last year's failed harvests, assess and petition for reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Where last year's harvest failed, assess losses and petition for tax reduction.

sentences.zh: 尤弊之處，遣使就郡縣隨宜賑卹。

translations.literal: In the worst-afflicted places, send envoys to the commanderies and counties to grant relief as appropriate on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: In the worst-afflicted districts, send envoys to the commanderies and counties to grant relief on the spot as circumstances require.

sentences.zh: 凡欲附農，而種糧匱乏者，並加給貸。

translations.literal: All who wish to attach to farming but lack seed grain are to be additionally granted loans.
translations.idiomatic: All who wish to return to farming but lack seed grain are to receive additional loans of grain.

sentences.zh: 營千畝諸統司役人，賜布各有差。

translations.literal: Those serving corvée in the thousand-mu camp and the various overseeing offices are to be granted cloth, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée laborers in the thousand-mu camp and the various overseeing offices are to be granted cloth, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 戊午，衞將軍臨川王義慶薨。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan and Guards General, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Guards General, died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以太子詹事劉義宗為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Liu Yizong, Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Liu Yizong, Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，以領軍將軍趙伯符為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengwu day, Zhao Bofu, General Who Leads the Army, was made Inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengwu day, Zhao Bofu, General Who Leads the Army, was made Inspector of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 己丑，司徒、錄尚書事江夏王義恭進位太尉，領司徒。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, was advanced to Grand Commandant and retained Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat, was advanced to Grand Commandant while retaining Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以右衞將軍沈演之為中領軍。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Right Guard, was made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Right Guard, was made General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，立第七皇子宏為建平王。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the seventh imperial son Hong was established as Prince of Jianping.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the seventh imperial son Hong was established as Prince of Jianping.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以廣陵王誕為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Dan, Prince of Guangling, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Prince of Guangling Dan was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling Commandery contributed a thousand hu of rice to aid relief for famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling Commandery contributed a thousand hu of rice to aid famine victims.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，以尚書何尚之為中護軍，諮議參軍劉道錫為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On renxu day of the fifth month, He Shangzhi, Director in the Imperial Secretariat, was made General Who Protects the Army; Liu Daoxi, Staff Officer for Consultation, was made Inspector of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day of the fifth month, He Shangzhi, Director in the Imperial Secretariat, was made General Who Protects the Army, and Liu Daoxi, Staff Officer for Consultation, was made Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 六月，連雨水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, rain fell continuously.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, rain fell continuously.

translations.literal: On dinghai day, an edict said: "For days on end the rains have poured; floods have become a calamity. The people have long been frugal and easily fall into want.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, an edict said: "For days on end the rains have poured; floods have become a calamity. The people have long lived frugally and easily fall into want.

translations.idiomatic: [31] Prince of Guangling Dan, Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Inspector of Southern Xu Province.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiachen day, Juqu Anzhou of Greater Juqu was made Campaigning-West General and Inspector of Liang Province and enfeoffed as King of Hexi.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao day, Xu Qiong, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Yan Province, and Shen Tian, Senior Clerk in the Grand General's Office, was made Inspector of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月辛卯朔，改用御史中丞何承天元嘉新曆。

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-second year, at the new moon on xinmao day, the Yuanjia New Calendar of He Chengtian, Imperial Censor, was adopted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史武陵王駿改為雍州刺史，湘州刺史南平王鑠為南豫州刺史。

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，以侍中王僧朗為湘州刺史。

translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinsi day, Wang Senglang, Palace Attendant, was made Inspector of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，立第八皇子褘為東海王，第九皇子昶為義陽王。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the eighth imperial son Yi was established as Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son Chang as Prince of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the eighth imperial son Yi was established as Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son Chang as Prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 夏六月辛亥，以南豫州刺史南平王鑠為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on xinhai day, Shuo, Prince of Nanping and Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was made Inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on xinhai day, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Inspector of Southern Yu Province, was made Inspector of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，以尚書僕射孟顗為尚書左僕射，中護軍何尚之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei day, Meng Yi, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director; He Shangzhi, General Who Protects the Army, was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei day, Meng Yi, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director, and He Shangzhi, General Who Protects the Army, was made Right Vice Director.

translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Yong Province, campaigned against the Man along the Han River and relocated more than fourteen thousand people to the capital.

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Campaigning-North Grand General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was reassigned Inspector of Xu Province.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiwei day, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were brought under cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were brought under cultivation.

translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day of the twelfth month, Fan Ye, Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household, plotted rebellion; he and his associates were all executed.

translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以前豫州刺史趙伯符為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Zhao Bofu, former Inspector of Yu Province, was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Zhao Bofu, former Inspector of Yu Province, was made General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月丁巳，以長沙內史陸徽為益州刺史。

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-third year, on dingsi day, Lu Hui, Administrator of Changsha, was made Inspector of Yi Province.

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Meng Yi, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, left office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Meng Yi, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, left office.

translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guimao day, Liu Yibin, General of the Left Guard, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

translations.idiomatic: At the new moon on guiwei day of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

translations.idiomatic: Tan Hezhi, Inspector of Jiao Province, attacked the kingdom of Linyi and conquered it.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao day, the Emperor visited the Imperial University, examined the students by question and answer, and fifty-nine passed.

translations.idiomatic: Having recently witnessed them in the examination in person, We saw their splendid array and, gazing toward Zhu and Si, ever cherish the age of the sages.

translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Jingxian, Senior Clerk in the Dragon Cavalry Office, was made Inspector of Jiao Province.

translations.idiomatic: That year there was a great harvest.

translations.idiomatic: The northern embankment was built, Black Tortoise Lake was established, and Jingyang Hill was raised in the Hualin Park.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月甲戌，大赦天下，文武賜位一等。

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-fourth year, on jiaxu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.

translations.idiomatic: Bound prisoners received reduced sentences; all overdue obligations were leniently reduced, each according to circumstance.

translations.idiomatic: Orphans, the aged, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.

translations.idiomatic: Half of this year's land tax for Jiankang and Moling counties was remitted.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renshen day, Zhao Bofu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred to another post.

translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on jiaxu day, Du Tan, Inspector of Qing Province, was additionally made Inspector of Ji Province.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, pestilence struck the capital; on bingxu day envoys were sent to the commanderies, counties, and camp and garrison supervising offices to make a general inspection and supply medicine.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，以林邑所獲金銀寶物，班賚各有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yimao day, gold, silver, and precious objects captured from Linyi were distributed as gifts, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yimao day, gold, silver, and precious objects captured from Linyi were distributed as gifts, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，征北大將軍、徐州刺史衡陽王義季薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiwei day, Yiji, Prince of Hengyang, Campaigning-North Grand General and Inspector of Xu Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiwei day, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Campaigning-North Grand General and Inspector of Xu Province, died.

translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Liu Yibin, Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Inspector of Xu Province.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiwei day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Central Army, was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiwei day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Central Army, was made General Who Leads the Army.

translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renwu day, Hu Danshi of Yuzhang rebelled and killed the Administrator Huan Longzhi; Tan Hezhi, former Inspector of Jiao Province, was returning south and, taking advantage of the route, suppressed and pacified the rebellion.

translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Prince of Jianping Hong was made General Who Protects the Army.

translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiayin day, the tenth imperial son Hun was established as Prince of Ruyin.

translations.literal: training troops and teaching warfare is the constant canon of a state.
translations.idiomatic: training troops and teaching warfare is the constant canon of a state.

translations.idiomatic: Therefore, once they are drilled in discipline and know shame, young and old alike understand prohibition.

translations.idiomatic: Recently military administration has been cultivated, yet orders and regulations have not been made clear.

translations.literal: Now that the Xuanwu training ground is newly completed, on a set day conduct a great drill of all the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Xuanwu training ground is newly completed, on a set day conduct a great drill of all the armies.
