translations.literal: At the same time hold a hunt review to exercise arms and discuss affairs of war."
translations.idiomatic: At the same time hold a hunt review to exercise arms and discuss affairs of war."

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，大蒐于宣武場。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jiyou day, a great hunt was held at the Xuanwu training ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiyou day, a great hunt was held at the Xuanwu training ground.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，車駕校獵。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengchen day, the imperial carriage conducted a hunt review.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengchen day, the Emperor conducted a hunt review.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，新作閶闔、廣莫二門，改先廣莫門曰承明，開陽曰津陽。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi day, the new Chunhe and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang was renamed Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi day, the new Chunhe and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang was renamed Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以撫軍將軍、雍州刺史武陵王駿為安北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yong Province, was made Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yong Province, was made Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以右衞將軍蕭思話為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Xiao Sihua, General of the Right Guard, was made Inspector of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Xiao Sihua, General of the Right Guard, was made Inspector of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，罷大錢當兩。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao day, large coins passing at two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao day, the decree that large coins pass at two was abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，零陵王司馬元瑜薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengxu day, Sima Yuanyu, Prince of Lingling, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu day, Sima Yuanyu, Prince of Lingling, died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，安北將軍、徐州刺史武陵王駿加兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province, was additionally made Inspector of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu Province, was additionally made Inspector of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車騎將軍、荊州刺史南譙王義宣進位司空。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Xuan, Prince of Nanqiao, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Prince of Nanqiao Xuan, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，左光祿大夫王敬弘薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu day, Wang Jinghong, Grand Master of Splendid Virtue of the Left, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu day, Wang Jinghong, Grand Master of Splendid Virtue of the Left, died.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以撫軍參軍劉秀之為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiyou day, Liu Xiuzhi, Staff Officer for the General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou day, Liu Xiuzhi, Staff Officer for the General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲子，立第十一皇子彧為淮陽王。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the eleventh imperial son Yu was established as Prince of Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the eleventh imperial son Yu was established as Prince of Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以尚書右僕射何尚之為尚書左僕射，領軍將軍沈演之遷職，吳興太守劉遵考為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinwei day, He Shangzhi, Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director; Shen Yanzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred to another post; Liu Zunkao, Administrator of Wuxing, was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinwei day, He Shangzhi, Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director; Shen Yanzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred to another post; and Liu Zunkao, Administrator of Wuxing, was made General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-sixth year, on xinsi day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-sixth year, on xinsi day, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，車駕陸道幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jihai day, the imperial carriage went by land to Dantu and paid respects at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai day, the Emperor traveled by land to Dantu and paid respects at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，[34]詔曰：「朕違北京，二十餘載，雖云密邇，瞻塗莫從。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingsi day, [34] an edict said: "We have been away from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is said to be close at hand, We have had no path by which to gaze upon the road.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingsi day, [34] an edict said: "We have been away from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is said to be close at hand, We have had no path by which to gaze upon the road.

sentences.zh: 今因四表無塵，時和歲稔，復獲拜奉舊塋，展罔極之思，饗讌故老，申追遠之懷。

translations.literal: Now that the four quarters are free of dust, seasons harmonious and years abundant, We have again been able to pay respects at the old tombs, display boundless filial feeling, feast and entertain old friends, and give voice to feelings of honoring the distant past.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the four quarters are at peace, seasons harmonious and harvests abundant, We have again been able to pay respects at the old tombs, display boundless filial devotion, feast old friends, and give voice to Our longing for those gone before.

sentences.zh: 固以義兼於桑梓，情加於過沛，永言慷慨，感慰實深。

translations.literal: Thus duty to native place and feeling for Pei are joined together; ever speaking of it brings forth generous feeling—the sense of comfort and gratitude is truly deep.
translations.idiomatic: Thus duty to native soil and affection for Pei are joined in one; ever dwelling on it stirs generous feeling—Our sense of comfort and gratitude runs truly deep.

sentences.zh: 宜聿宣仁惠，覃被率土。

translations.literal: It is fitting earnestly to proclaim benevolence and favor and spread them over all the land.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting earnestly to proclaim benevolence and favor and spread them throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 其大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty is proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty is proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 復丹徒縣僑舊今歲租布之半。

translations.literal: Remit half this year's cloth tax for migrant natives in Dantu County.
translations.idiomatic: Remit half this year's cloth tax for migrant natives in Dantu County.

sentences.zh: 行所經縣，蠲田租之半。

translations.literal: In the counties the route passes through, remit half the land tax.
translations.idiomatic: In the counties along the imperial route, remit half the land tax.

sentences.zh: 二千石官長並勤勞王務，宜有沾錫。

translations.literal: Chiefs at the two-thousand-shi level who have all labored diligently in royal affairs should receive a share of bounty.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects and magistrates who have all labored diligently in royal affairs should receive a share of imperial bounty.

sentences.zh: 登城三戰及大將戰亡墜沒之家，老病單弱者，普加贍卹。

translations.literal: Households of those killed or lost in the three Wall battles and great-generals' campaigns, and the old, sick, solitary, or weak—universally add relief and support.
translations.idiomatic: Households of those killed or lost in the three Wall battles and in great-generals' campaigns, and the old, sick, solitary, or weak—all are to receive relief and support.

sentences.zh: 遣使巡行百姓，問所疾苦。

translations.literal: Send envoys to tour among the people and inquire into their hardships.
translations.idiomatic: Send envoys to tour among the people and inquire into their hardships.

sentences.zh: 孤老、鰥寡、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: The orphaned aged, widowers and widows, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves—each grant five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: The orphaned aged, widowers and widows, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves are each granted five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 」遣使祭晉故司空忠肅公何無忌之墓。

translations.literal: " Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tomb of former Jin Minister of Works and Loyal and Solemn Duke He Wuji.
translations.idiomatic: " Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tomb of He Wuji, former Jin Minister of Works and Loyal and Solemn Duke.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，申南北沛下邳三郡復。

translations.literal: On yichou day, tax remissions for the three commanderies Northern Pei, Southern Pei, and Xiapi were announced.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, tax remissions for the three commanderies Northern Pei, Southern Pei, and Xiapi were announced.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「京口肇祥自古，著符近代，衿帶江山，表裏華甸，經塗四達，利盡淮、海，城邑高明，土風淳壹，苞總形勝，實唯名都。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "Jingkou from antiquity was the place where auspiciousness first arose and carried outward signs in recent times; girdled by rivers and mountains, within and without the splendid heartland, roads crossing in all directions, profit exhausting the Huai and sea—its cities lofty and bright, local custom pure and uniform; gathering all strategic advantage, it is truly a famous capital.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "Jingkou from antiquity was where auspiciousness first arose and where recent ages found their signs; girdled by rivers and mountains, within and without the splendid heartland, with roads crossing in all directions and profit reaching the Huai and the sea—its cities lofty and bright, its local ways pure and uniform; gathering every strategic advantage, it is truly a famous capital.

sentences.zh: 故能光宅靈心，克昌帝業。

translations.literal: Therefore it could illumine the numinous heart and bring flourishing to the imperial enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore it could illumine the numinous heart and bring flourishing to the imperial enterprise.

sentences.zh: 頃年岳牧遷回，軍民徙散，廛里廬宇，不逮往日。

translations.literal: In recent years provincial governors have shifted back and forth, troops and people scattered and dispersed; market wards and dwellings no longer match former days.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years provincial governors have shifted back and forth, troops and people scattered and dispersed, and market wards and dwellings no longer match former days.

sentences.zh: 皇基舊鄉，地兼蕃重，宜令殷阜，式崇形望。

translations.literal: The old homeland of the imperial foundation, its territory doubly eminent and weighty—should be made prosperous and thereby elevate its visible prestige.
translations.idiomatic: The old homeland of the imperial foundation, its territory doubly eminent and weighty, should be made prosperous and thereby elevate its visible prestige.

sentences.zh: 可募諸州樂移者數千家，給以田宅，并蠲復。」

translations.literal: Recruit from the various provinces several thousand households willing to relocate, grant them fields and houses, and remit their taxes."
translations.idiomatic: Recruit from the various provinces several thousand households willing to relocate, grant them fields and houses, and remit their taxes."

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，詔曰：「吾生於此城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingyin day, an edict said: "I was born in this city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingyin day, an edict said: "I was born in this city.

sentences.zh: 及盧循肆亂，害流茲境。

translations.literal: When Lu Xun wrought chaos, harm flowed through this territory.
translations.idiomatic: When Lu Xun wrought chaos, harm flowed through this territory.

sentences.zh: 先帝以桑梓根本，實同休戚，復以蒙稚，猥同艱難，情義繾綣，夷險兼備，舊物遺蹤，猶存心目。

translations.literal: The late Emperor, because of native roots, truly shared fortune and woe; when I was still young I unworthily shared the hardship—affection and duty closely bound, peace and peril together complete; old things and traces left behind still remain before my eyes.
translations.idiomatic: The late Emperor, because this was native soil, truly shared fortune and woe with it; when I was still young I unworthily shared the hardship—affection and duty closely bound, peace and peril together endured; old things and traces left behind still remain before my eyes.

sentences.zh: 歲月不居，逝踰三紀，時人故老，與運零落。

translations.literal: Years do not stay; more than three decades have passed; the people of that time and the old friends have fallen away with fate.
translations.idiomatic: Years do not stay; more than three decades have passed; the people of that time and the old friends have fallen away with fate.

sentences.zh: 眷惟既往，倍深感歎。

translations.literal: Looking back on what is past, Our feeling of sighing is doubly deep.
translations.idiomatic: Looking back on what is past, Our feeling of sighing is doubly deep.

sentences.zh: 可搜訪于時士庶文武今尚存者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Search out civil and military gentry and commoners of that time who still survive and report all their names.
translations.idiomatic: Search out civil and military gentry and commoners of that time who still survive and report all their names.

sentences.zh: 人身已亡而子孫見在，優量賜賚之。

translations.literal: Those already dead but whose descendants are living shall receive generous bounty according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: Those already dead but whose descendants still live shall receive generous bounty according to merit.

sentences.zh: 」車駕水路發丹徒，壬午，至京師。

translations.literal: " The imperial carriage set out by water from Dantu; on renwu day it reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: " The imperial carriage set out by water from Dantu; on renwu day it reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，婆皇國，壬辰，婆達國，並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the state of Ba Huang, and on renchen day the state of Ba Da, both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the state of Ba Huang, and on renchen day the state of Ba Da, both sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，以江州刺史廬陵王紹為南徐州刺史，廣陵王誕為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei day, Shao, Prince of Luling and Inspector of Jiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Xu Province, and Dan, Prince of Guangling, was made Inspector of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei day, Prince of Luling Shao, Inspector of Jiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Xu Province, and Prince of Guangling Dan was made Inspector of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以中護軍建平王宏為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiyou day of the eighth month, Hong, Prince of Jianping and Central Army Guard, was made Inspector of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day of the eighth month, Prince of Jianping Hong, Central Army Guard, was made Inspector of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以南豐王朗為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Lang, Prince of Nanfeng, was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was made Inspector of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，廣陵王誕改封隨郡王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Dan, Prince of Guangling, was redesignated Prince of Suixiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was redesignated Prince of Suixiang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史始興王濬為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐兗二州刺史，南徐州刺史廬陵王紹為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Jun, Prince of Shixing, Central Army General and Inspector of Yang Province, was made Campaigning-North General, Secretariat-Director-with-the-Same-Three-Staff, and Inspector of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Shao, Prince of Luling and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made Inspector of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Central Army General and Inspector of Yang Province, was made Campaigning-North General, Secretariat-Director-with-the-Same-Three-Staff, and Inspector of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Prince of Luling Shao, Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made Inspector of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月辛未，制交、寧二州假板郡縣，俸祿聽依臺除。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-seventh year, on xinwei day, provisional plate-holding commanderies and counties in Jiao and Ning provinces were regulated; salaries were to follow metropolitan appointment standards.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-seventh year, on xinwei day, regulations were set for provisional plate-holding commanderies and counties in Jiao and Ning provinces; salaries were to follow metropolitan appointment standards.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，右將軍、豫州刺史南平王鑠進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: On xinchou day of the second month, Shuo, Prince of Nanping, Right General and Inspector of Yu Province, was advanced to Campaigning-West General.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day of the second month, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Right General and Inspector of Yu Province, was advanced to Campaigning-West General.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，[35]索虜寇汝南諸郡，陳南頓二郡太守鄭琨、汝陽潁川二郡太守郭道隱委守走。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, [35] the Northern Barbarians raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of the two commanderies Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of the two commanderies Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, [35] the Northern Barbarians raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun commanderies, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan commanderies, abandoned their posts and fled.

sentences.zh: 索虜攻懸瓠城，行汝南郡事陳憲拒之。

translations.literal: The Northern Barbarians attacked Xuanhu city; Chen Xian, acting for Runan Commandery, resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Barbarians attacked Xuanhu city; Chen Xian, acting for Runan Commandery, resisted them.

sentences.zh: 以軍興減百官俸三分之一。

translations.literal: Because of military exigency, all officials' salaries were reduced by one third.
translations.idiomatic: Because of military exigency, all officials' salaries were reduced by one third.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，淮南太守諸葛闡求減俸祿同內百官，於是州及郡縣丞尉並悉同減。

translations.literal: On yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Chan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced like those of metropolitan officials; thereupon officials at the provincial, commandery, and county levels and assistant wardens were all likewise reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Chan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced like those of metropolitan officials; thereupon officials at the provincial, commandery, and county levels and assistant wardens were all likewise reduced.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷國子學。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the Imperial University was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Imperial University was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以新除吏部尚書蕭思話為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Defender-General.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Defender-General.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，安北將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On renzi day of the fourth month of summer, Jun, Prince of Wuling, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced to General Who Settles the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day of the fourth month of summer, Prince of Wuling Jun, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced to General Who Settles the Army.

translations.literal: Textual annotation marker thirty-six in the received text.
translations.idiomatic: The received edition inserts commentary marker thirty-six at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，侍中蕭斌為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingyou day of the sixth month, Bin, Palace Attendant, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day of the sixth month, Bin, Palace Attendant, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，遣寧朔將軍王玄謨北伐。

translations.literal: On gengwu day of the seventh month of autumn, Pacifying-Insurgent General Wang Xuanmo was sent on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day of the seventh month of autumn, Wang Xuanmo, Pacifying-Insurgent General, was sent on a northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 太尉江夏王義恭出次彭城，總統諸軍。

translations.literal: Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and Grand Commandant, went out and encamped at Pengcheng to command all armies.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand Commandant, went out and encamped at Pengcheng to command all armies.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，索虜碻磝戍委城走。

translations.literal: On yihai day, the Northern Barbarian garrison at Quepo abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Northern Barbarian garrison at Quepo abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 冬閏月癸亥，玄謨攻滑臺，不克，為虜所敗，退還碻磝。

translations.literal: On guihai day of the intercalary winter month, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but did not take it; he was defeated by the barbarians and withdrew to Quepo.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the intercalary winter month, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but did not take it; he was defeated by the barbarians and withdrew to Quepo.

sentences.zh: 辛未，雍州刺史隨王誕遣軍攻弘農城，克之。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Dan, Prince of Suixiang and Inspector of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong city and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Prince of Suixiang Dan, Inspector of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong city and took it.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，又克關城。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, they also took Guan city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, they also took Guan city.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，索虜陷鄒山，魯、陽平二郡太守崔邪利沒。

translations.literal: On wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Northern Barbarians took Mount Zou; Cui Xieli, Administrator of the two commanderies Lu and Yangping, was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Northern Barbarians took Mount Zou; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping commanderies, was captured.

sentences.zh: 甲午，隨王誕所遣軍又攻陝城，克之。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the army sent by Prince of Suixiang Dan again attacked Shancheng and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the army sent by Prince of Suixiang Dan again attacked Shancheng and took it.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，左軍將軍劉康祖於壽陽尉武戍與虜戰敗見殺。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left Army, was defeated in battle with the barbarians at the Wu fortress in Shouyang and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left Army, was defeated in battle with the barbarians at the Wu fortress in Shouyang and was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，內外纂嚴。

translations.literal: On wuwu day of the twelfth month, martial preparations were tightened within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the twelfth month, martial preparations were tightened within and without.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，冗從僕射胡崇之、太子積弩將軍臧澄之、建威將軍毛熙祚於盱眙與虜戰敗，並見殺。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary, Zang Chengzhi, Accumulated Crossbows General of the Crown Prince, and Mao Xizuo, Establishing Might General, were defeated in battle with the barbarians at Xuyi and all were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary, Zang Chengzhi, Accumulated Crossbows General of the Crown Prince, and Mao Xizuo, Establishing Might General, were defeated in battle with the barbarians at Xuyi and all were killed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，虜偽主率大眾至瓜步。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the barbarian pretender led a great host to Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the barbarian pretender led a great host to Guabu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On renwu day, martial law was proclaimed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, martial law was proclaimed within and without.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月丙戌朔，以寇逼不朝會。

translations.literal: At the new moon on bingxu day of the first month of spring in the twenty-eighth year, the court assembly was not held because of the enemy threat.
translations.idiomatic: At the new moon on bingxu day of the first month of spring in the twenty-eighth year, the court assembly was not held because of the enemy threat.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，索虜自瓜步退走。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, the Northern Barbarians withdrew from Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Northern Barbarians withdrew from Guabu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，攻圍盱眙城。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi city.

sentences.zh: 是月，寧朔將軍王玄謨自碻磝退還歷下。

translations.literal: That month, Wang Xuanmo, Pacifying-Insurgent General, withdrew from Quepo and returned to Lixia.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wang Xuanmo, Pacifying-Insurgent General, withdrew from Quepo and returned to Lixia.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，索虜自盱眙奔走。

translations.literal: On bingchen day of the second month, the Northern Barbarians fled from Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day of the second month, the Northern Barbarians fled from Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔曰：「玁狁孔熾，難及數州，眷言念之，鑒寐興悼。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun blaze fiercely; disaster reaches several provinces—looking back on them, I wake and sleep in grief.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun blaze fiercely; disaster reaches several provinces—dwelling on them, I wake and sleep in grief.

sentences.zh: 凶羯痍挫，迸跡遠奔，彫傷之民，宜時振理。

translations.literal: The brutal Jie have been wounded and shattered, fleeing far in flight; the people cut down and injured should now be restored and put in order.
translations.idiomatic: The brutal Jie have been wounded and shattered, fleeing far in flight; the people cut down and injured should now be restored and put in order.

sentences.zh: 凡遭寇賊郡縣，令還復居業，封屍掩骼，賑贍饑流。

translations.literal: In all commanderies and counties that suffered barbarian raids, order them to return and resume their livelihoods; bury exposed corpses and cover bare bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced.
translations.idiomatic: In all commanderies and counties that suffered barbarian raids, order the people to return and resume their livelihoods; bury exposed corpses and cover bare bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced.

sentences.zh: 東作方始，務盡勸課。

translations.literal: Eastern labor is just beginning—strive to the utmost in encouraging cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Spring labor is just beginning—strive to the utmost in encouraging cultivation.

sentences.zh: 貸給之宜，事從優厚。

translations.literal: Provisions for loans and grants should in every case be generous.
translations.idiomatic: Provisions for loans and grants should in every case be generous.

sentences.zh: 其流寓江、淮者，並聽即屬，并蠲復稅調。

translations.literal: Those who have drifted to the Jiang and Huai regions are all permitted to register where they are and likewise receive remission of tax and corvée levies.
translations.idiomatic: Those who have drifted to the Jiang and Huai regions are all permitted to register where they are and likewise receive remission of tax and corvée levies.

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，太尉、領司徒江夏王義恭降為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: " On jiaxu day, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, Grand Commandant and concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to Rapid Cavalry General, Secretariat-Director-with-the-Same-Three-Staff.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiaxu day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand Commandant and concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to Rapid Cavalry General, Secretariat-Director-with-the-Same-Three-Staff.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，鎮軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號北中郎將。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Jun, Prince of Wuling, General Who Settles the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced to North Central Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Settles the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced to North Central Commander.

sentences.zh: 壬午，車駕幸瓜步，是日解嚴。

translations.literal: On renwu day, the imperial carriage visited Guabu; that day martial law was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the imperial carriage visited Guabu; that day martial law was lifted.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On yiyou day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，征北將軍始興王濬解南兗州。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Jun, Prince of Shixing and Campaigning-North General, was relieved of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Campaigning-North General, was relieved of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以輔國將軍臧質為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Zhi, Supporting-State General, was made Inspector of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Zang Zhi, Supporting-State General, was made Inspector of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐州刺史武陵王駿為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Jun, Prince of Wuling and Inspector of Xu Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Xu Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，護軍將軍蕭思話為撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, Defender-General, was made Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, Defender-General, was made Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，婆達國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On guiyou day of the fourth month of summer, the state of Ba Da sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fourth month of summer, the state of Ba Da sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 索虜偽寧南將軍魯爽、中書郎魯秀歸順。

translations.literal: Lu Shuang, the Northern Barbarians' pretender Pacifying-South General, and Lu Xiu, Secretariat Attendant, submitted to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shuang, the Northern Barbarians' pretender Pacifying-South General, and Lu Xiu, Secretariat Attendant, submitted to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以爽為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Shuang was made Inspector of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Shuang was made Inspector of Si Province.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，亡命司馬順則自號齊王，據梁鄒城。

translations.literal: On yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，婆皇國，戊戌，河南王，並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On dingsi day the state of Ba Huang, and on wuxu day the King of Henan, both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the state of Ba Huang, and on wuxu day the King of Henan, both sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: [37]己巳，驃騎將軍江夏王義恭領南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: [37] On jisi day, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and Rapid Cavalry General, concurrently held Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: [37] On jisi day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Rapid Cavalry General, concurrently held Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以尚書左僕射何尚之為尚書令，太子詹事徐湛之為尚書僕射、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On wushen day, He Shangzhi, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Xu Zhanzhi, Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Defender-General.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, He Shangzhi, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Xu Zhanzhi, Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Defender-General.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以後將軍隨王誕為安南將軍、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Dan, Prince of Suixiang and General of the Rear, was made Pacifying-South General and Inspector of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Prince of Suixiang Dan, General of the Rear, was made Pacifying-South General and Inspector of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，以北中郎將武陵王駿為江州刺史，以振武將軍、秦郡太守劉興祖為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On renxu day of the sixth month, Jun, Prince of Wuling and North Central Commander, was made Inspector of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, Quelling-Wu General and Administrator of Qin Commandery, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun, North Central Commander, was made Inspector of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, Quelling-Wu General and Administrator of Qin Commandery, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，安東將軍倭王倭濟進號安東大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiachen day of the seventh month of autumn, Wajin, Prince of Wa and Pacifying-East General, was advanced to Pacifying-East Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the seventh month of autumn, Wajin, Prince of Wa and Pacifying-East General, was advanced to Pacifying-East Grand General.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，梁鄒平，斬司馬順則。

translations.literal: On guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On guihai day of the tenth month of winter, Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the tenth month of winter, Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，曲赦二兗、徐、豫、青、冀六州。

translations.literal: On renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was granted in the six provinces Southern Yan, Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was granted in the six provinces Southern Yan, Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 是冬，徙彭城流民於瓜步，淮西流民於姑孰，合萬許家。

translations.literal: That winter, refugees from Pengcheng were relocated to Guabu and Huai West refugees to Gushu, together about ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, refugees from Pengcheng were relocated to Guabu and Huai West refugees to Gushu, together about ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月甲午，詔曰：「經寇六州，居業未立，[38]仍值災澇，饑困荐臻。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-ninth year, on jiawu day, an edict said: "Having endured raids across six provinces, livelihoods are not yet established; [38] they have again met with flood disasters, and hunger and distress come repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-ninth year, on jiawu day, an edict said: "Having endured raids across six provinces, livelihoods are not yet established; [38] they have again met with flood disasters, and hunger and distress come repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 可速符諸鎮，優量救卹。

translations.literal: Quickly dispatch orders to all garrisons and generously assess relief.
translations.idiomatic: Quickly dispatch orders to all garrisons and generously assess relief.

sentences.zh: 今農事行興，務盡地利。

translations.literal: Now agricultural work is underway—strive to exhaust the land's advantage.
translations.idiomatic: Now agricultural work is underway—strive to exhaust the land's advantage.

sentences.zh: 若須田種，隨宜給之。」

translations.literal: If seed for fields is needed, grant it as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: If seed for fields is needed, grant it as appropriate."

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，虜帥拓跋燾死。

translations.literal: On gengshen day of the second month, the barbarian commander Tuo Ba Tao died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day of the second month, the barbarian commander Tuo Ba Tao died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，[39]立第十二皇子休仁為建安王。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was established as Prince of Jian'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was established as Prince of Jian'an.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On wuwu day of the fourth month of summer, Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the fourth month of summer, Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 以驃騎參軍張永為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong, Staff Officer in the Rapid Cavalry office, was made Inspector of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong, Staff Officer in the Rapid Cavalry office, was made Inspector of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，罷湘州并荊州。

translations.literal: On jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 以始興、臨賀、始安三郡屬廣州，丙申，詔曰：「惡稔身滅，戎醜常數，虐虜窮凶，著於自昔。

translations.literal: The three commanderies Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were assigned to Guang Province; on bingshen day an edict said: "When wickedness is full the body perishes—barbarian villains meet their allotted reckoning; the cruel barbarian at the end of his malice, notorious from former ages.
translations.idiomatic: The three commanderies Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were assigned to Guang Province; on bingshen day an edict said: "When wickedness is full the body perishes—barbarian villains meet their allotted reckoning; the cruel barbarian, to the end of his malice, has been notorious from former ages.

sentences.zh: 未勞資斧，已伏天誅，子孫相殘，親黨離貳，關、洛偽帥，並懷內款，河朔遺民，注誠請効。

translations.literal: Without yet laboring the battle-axe, they have already submitted to Heaven's punishment; descendants slaughter one another, kin and clansmen split in two; the false commanders at Tong and Luo all harbor inward sincerity, and the remnant people north of the Yellow River pour forth loyalty and beg to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Without Our armies yet striking, they have already fallen under Heaven's judgment; their sons and grandsons turn on one another, kin and allies divide; the puppet leaders at Tong and Luo all nurse secret submission, and the people left north of the Yellow River set their hearts on Us and beg to serve.

sentences.zh: 拯溺蕩穢，今其會也。

translations.literal: To rescue the drowning and sweep away filth—now is the moment.
translations.idiomatic: To rescue the drowning and cleanse the foul—now is the hour.

sentences.zh: 可符驃騎、司空二府，各部分所統，東西應接。

translations.literal: Let orders be sent to the two offices of Rapid Cavalry and Minister of Works, each to command what they govern and coordinate east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Let orders go to the Rapid Cavalry and Minister of Works offices, each to take command of its forces and link east and west.

sentences.zh: 歸義建績者，隨勞酬獎。

translations.literal: Those who submit in loyalty and build merit are to be rewarded according to their labor.
translations.idiomatic: Those who come over in good faith and earn merit shall be rewarded in proportion to their service.

sentences.zh: 」是月，京邑雨水。

translations.literal: " That month the capital had flooding rain.
translations.idiomatic: " That month the capital was deluged with rain.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，遣部司巡行，賜樵米，給船。

translations.literal: On jiyou day of the sixth month, the departmental office was sent on tour, granting firewood and grain and supplying boats.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day of the sixth month, the departmental office was sent on circuit, distributing firewood and grain and providing boats.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍蕭思話率眾北伐。

translations.literal: Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army, led the host on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army, led his forces north.

sentences.zh: 以征北從事中郎劉瑀為益州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Yu, Attendant-in-Ordinary on the North Campaigning staff, was made Inspector of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, Attendant-in-Ordinary on the North Campaigning staff, was appointed Inspector of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，汝陰王渾改封武昌王，淮陽王彧改封湘東王。

translations.literal: On renchen day of the seventh month of autumn, Hun, Prince of Ruyin, was re-enfeoffed Prince of Wuchang, and Yu, Prince of Huaiyang, was re-enfeoffed Prince of Xiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the seventh month of autumn, Prince of Ruyin Hun was re-enfeoffed Prince of Wuchang, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu was re-enfeoffed Prince of Xiangdong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，省大司農、太子僕、廷尉監官。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the posts of Grand Minister of Agriculture, Palace Steward, and Supervisor of the Court of Justice were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the offices of Grand Minister of Agriculture, Palace Steward, and Supervisor of the Court of Justice were abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，蕭思話攻碻磝，不拔，退還。

translations.literal: On dingmao day of the eighth month, Xiao Sihua attacked Qiaoduan but did not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the eighth month, Xiao Sihua attacked Qiaoduan, failed to capture it, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，以平西將軍吐谷渾拾寅為安西將軍、秦河二州刺史。

translations.literal: On dinghai day of the ninth month, Shibin of Tuyuhun, Pacifying-West General, was made Secure-West General and Inspector of Qin and He provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the ninth month, Shibin of Tuyuhun, Pacifying-West General, was made Secure-West General and Inspector of Qin and He provinces.

sentences.zh: 己丑，撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史蕭思話加冀州刺史，兗州如故。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was additionally made Inspector of Ji Province; his Yan post remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was additionally made Inspector of Ji Province while retaining Yan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，司州刺史魯爽攻虎牢不拔，退還。

translations.literal: On guihai day of the tenth month of winter, Lu Shuang, Inspector of Si Province, attacked Hulao but did not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the tenth month of winter, Lu Shuang, Inspector of Si Province, attacked Hulao, failed to capture it, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，揚州刺史廬陵王紹薨。

translations.literal: On renyin day of the eleventh month, Shao, Prince of Luling and Inspector of Yang Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day of the eleventh month, Prince of Luling Shao, Inspector of Yang Province, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，以驃騎將軍、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為大將軍、南徐州刺史，錄尚書事如故。

translations.literal: On xinwei day of the twelfth month, Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, Rapid Cavalry General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Grand General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat as before.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day of the twelfth month, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Rapid Cavalry General and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Grand General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, retaining his post as Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月戊寅，以司空、荊州刺史南譙王義宣為司徒、中軍將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the thirtieth year, on wuyin day, Xuan, Prince of Nanqiao, Minister of Works and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Minister over the Masses, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the thirtieth year, on wuyin day, Prince of Nanqiao Xuan, Minister of Works and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Minister over the Masses, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 以南兗州并南徐州。

translations.literal: Southern Yan Province was merged into Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Yan Province was merged into Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以領軍將軍劉遵考為平西將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Liu Zunkao, General Who Leads the Army, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Liu Zunkao, General Who Leads the Army, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以征北將軍、南徐州刺史始興王濬為衛將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Jun, Prince of Shixing, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made Military Guard General and Inspector of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made Military Guard General and Inspector of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 戊子，江州刺史武陵王駿統眾軍伐西陽蠻。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Jun, Prince of Wuling and Inspector of Jiang Province, commanded the host in attacking the Xiyang Man.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Jiang Province, commanded the armies in a campaign against the Xiyang Man.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以豫州刺史南平王鑠為撫軍將軍、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Shuo, Prince of Nanping and Inspector of Yu Province, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Inspector of Yu Province, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 青、徐州饑，二月壬子，遣運部賑卹。

translations.literal: Qing and Xu provinces suffered famine; on renzi day of the second month the Transport Office was sent to relieve and succor.
translations.idiomatic: Qing and Xu provinces were stricken with famine; on renzi day of the second month the Transport Office was dispatched to grant relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上崩于含章殿。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the Emperor died in the Hall of Containing Elegance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Emperor died in the Hall of Containing Elegance.

sentences.zh: 時年四十七。

translations.literal: He was forty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He was forty-seven.

sentences.zh: 諡曰景皇帝，廟曰中宗。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Emperor Jing; his temple name was Zhongzong.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Emperor Jing; his temple name was Zhongzong.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，葬長寧陵。

translations.literal: On guisi day of the third month he was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day of the third month he was buried at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 世祖踐阼，追改諡及廟號。

translations.literal: When Shizu ascended the throne, the posthumous title and temple name were retroactively changed.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizu took the throne, the posthumous title and temple name were altered retroactively.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：太祖幼年特秀，顧無保傅之嚴，而天授和敏之姿，自禀君人之德。

translations.literal: The historian writes: In his youth Taizu was outstandingly gifted; though he lacked the strict tutelage of guardian and tutor, Heaven had bestowed on him a gentle and keen nature, and he was naturally endowed with the virtue of a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: Taizu was precociously brilliant; though he never received the stern schooling of guardian and tutor, Heaven had given him a gentle, quick mind, and he bore the virtue of a sovereign by nature.

sentences.zh: 及正位南面，歷年長久，綱維備舉，條禁明密，罰有恒科，爵無濫品。

translations.literal: Once he faced south upon the throne, his years were long; the framework was fully in place, statutes and prohibitions clear and tight, punishments had fixed grades, and ranks had no careless bestowal.
translations.idiomatic: Once enthroned, he reigned many years; every strand of governance was in order, laws and bans lucid and strict, punishments followed fixed statutes, and ennoblement knew no careless rank.

sentences.zh: 故能內清外晏，四海謐如也。

translations.literal: Thus within was purity and without was peace; the four seas were serene as if at rest.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the inner court was pure and the outer realm tranquil; all under Heaven lay quiet as if at peace.

sentences.zh: 昔漢氏東京常稱建武、永平故事，自茲厥後，亦每以元嘉為言，斯固盛矣。

translations.literal: Formerly the Eastern Han of the Han house often invoked the precedents of Jianwu and Yongping; from that time onward men likewise spoke of Yuanjia—truly it was a flourishing age.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Eastern Han writers often cited the models of Jianwu and Yongping; after that age too men spoke of Yuanjia in the same breath—truly it was a golden time.

sentences.zh: 授將遣帥，乖分閫之命，才謝光武，而遙制兵略，至於攻日戰時，莫不仰聽成旨。

translations.literal: In appointing generals and dispatching commanders he contravened the division of frontier commands; his talent fell short of Guangwu, yet he controlled strategy from afar—when the day of battle came, all looked up to hear the finalized imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: In appointing generals and sending commanders he overrode the proper division of frontier authority; his gifts were no match for Guangwu's, yet he directed strategy from the capital—on the day of battle every commander waited upon the throne's final word.

sentences.zh: 雖覆師喪旅，將非韓、白，而延寇慼境，抑此之由。

translations.literal: Though armies were destroyed and hosts lost, and his generals were no Han Xin or Bai Qi, that the enemy lingered and the borders suffered grief—this too had its cause here.
translations.idiomatic: Though campaigns ended in ruin and his commanders were no Han Xin or Bai Qi, that the foe lingered and the frontiers bled—this too stemmed from that habit.

sentences.zh: 及至言漏衾衽，難結商豎，雖禍生非慮，蓋亦有以而然也。

translations.literal: When at last words leaked at the bed curtain and trouble knotted with a peddler, though calamity arose beyond forethought, surely there were reasons for it to be so.
translations.idiomatic: When at last whispers escaped the bed curtain and scandal bound him to a petty trader, though disaster came unlooked-for, there were reasons enough.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！

translations.literal: Alas! How pitiable!
translations.idiomatic: Alas! How pitiable!

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation notes

sentences.zh: 車駕至京城 孫虨宋書考論云：「當作京邑。

translations.literal: "The imperial carriage reached the capital city"—Sun Ao's Critical Study of the Song History says: "It should read the capital (jingyi).
translations.idiomatic: On "the imperial carriage reached the capital city": Sun Ao's Critical Study of the Song History says it should read jingyi (the capital).

sentences.zh: 京城則京口矣。

translations.literal: Capital city (jingcheng) would mean Jingkou."
translations.idiomatic: Jingcheng would mean Jingkou."

sentences.zh: 」按通鑑作建康。

translations.literal: Comment: the Comprehensive Mirror reads Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Note: Zizhi Tongjian reads Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 宋書京城往往指京口城，此則指建康。

translations.literal: In the Song History jingcheng often denotes Jingkou city; here it refers to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song History jingcheng usually means Jingkou; here the passage means Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 辛未車駕祠南郊 各本並脫「辛未」二字，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑補。

translations.literal: "On xinwei the imperial carriage sacrificed at the Southern Suburb"—all editions omit the two characters xinwei; supplied per the Southern History, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: On "xinwei, the imperial carriage sacrificed at the Southern Suburb": all editions drop xinwei; the date is restored from the Southern History, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅 「潘盛」各本作「潘城」，據少帝紀、徐羨之傳改。

translations.literal: "The Administrator of Jian'an Pan Sheng was guilty and executed"—"Pan Sheng" in all editions reads "Pan Cheng"; emended per the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Xu Xianzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On "Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian'an, was guilty and executed": all editions read Pan Cheng for Pan Sheng; corrected per the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Xu Xianzhi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯 各本並作「己卯」，據局本及南史改。

translations.literal: "Yimao"—all editions read "jimao"; emended per the Bureau edition and Southern History.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao: all editions read jimao; emended per the Bureau edition and Southern History.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁酉朔，十九日乙卯，無己卯。

translations.literal: Comment: that month had dingyou as the new moon; the nineteenth day was yimao—there is no jimao.
translations.idiomatic: Note: that month began on dingyou; the nineteenth day was yimao—jimao is impossible.

sentences.zh: 領平北將軍南徐州刺史 各本並脫「南」字，按彭城王義康傳、建康實錄、通鑑並作南徐州刺史，今據補。

translations.literal: "Concurrent Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province"—all editions drop the character for South; the biography of Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror all read Inspector of Southern Xu Province; now supplied.
translations.idiomatic: On "Concurrent Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province": all editions omit South; the biography of Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror agree on Southern Xu; restored accordingly.

sentences.zh: 以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史 各本並脫「尹」字，按索虜傳，時尹沖為司州刺史，通鑑同。

translations.literal: "Former Campaigning-North Army Major Yin Chong was made Inspector of Si Province"—all editions drop the character Yin; the biography of the Northern Barbarians shows Yin Chong as Inspector of Si Province at the time, and the Comprehensive Mirror agrees.
translations.idiomatic: On "former Campaigning-North Army Major Yin Chong made Inspector of Si Province": all editions omit Yin; the barbarian biography and Comprehensive Mirror place Yin Chong in that office; restored.

sentences.zh: 今據補。

translations.literal: Now supplied.
translations.idiomatic: The name is now restored.

sentences.zh: 征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張 各本並脫「平」字。

translations.literal: "Campaigning-South Grand General Tan Daoji defeated the Northern Barbarians at Dongping Shouzhang"—all editions drop the character ping.
translations.idiomatic: On "Tan Daoji, Campaigning-South Grand General, defeated the Northern Barbarians at Dongping Shouzhang": all editions omit ping.

sentences.zh: 據檀道濟傳補。

translations.literal: Supplied per the biography of Tan Daoji.
translations.idiomatic: Ping is supplied from the biography of Tan Daoji.

sentences.zh: 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「按檀道濟傳作東平壽張，此『東』下脫『平』字。」

translations.literal: Hong Yixuan, Variorum Notes on the Histories, says: "The biography of Tan Daoji reads Dongping Shouzhang; here the character ping has dropped after dong."
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yixuan, Variorum Notes on the Histories, writes: "Tan Daoji's biography has Dongping Shouzhang; ping has dropped after dong here."

sentences.zh: 苟不深存務本 各本並脫「苟」字，據元龜一九八補。

translations.literal: "If one does not deeply preserve the root of affairs"—all editions drop the character gou; supplied per Yuan Gui 198.
translations.idiomatic: On "if one does not deeply preserve the root of affairs": all editions omit gou; restored per Yuan Gui 198.

sentences.zh: 以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍 「慕容延」本書吐谷渾傳作「慕延」。

translations.literal: "Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-East General"—"Murong Yan" in this book's Tuyuhun biography reads "Mu Yan."
translations.idiomatic: On "Murong Yan of Tuyuhun made Pacifying-East General": this book's Tuyuhun biography reads Mu Yan for Murong Yan.

sentences.zh: 魏書作「慕利延」。

translations.literal: The Wei History reads "Mu Liyan."
translations.idiomatic: The Wei History reads Mu Liyan.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍 各本並脫「谷」字，據前後文例補。

translations.literal: "Huifa of Tuyuhun was made General Who Stabilizes the Army"—all editions drop the character gu; supplied per the usage before and after.
translations.idiomatic: On "Huifa of Tuyuhun made General Who Stabilizes the Army": all editions omit gu in Tuyuhun; restored by context.

sentences.zh: 「輝伐」魏書作「緯代」。

translations.literal: "Huifa" in the Wei History reads "Weidai."
translations.idiomatic: Huifa in the Wei History appears as Weidai.

sentences.zh: 壬申河南國河西王遣使獻方物 「河西王」各本作「西河王」，據少帝紀景平元年及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。

translations.literal: "On renshen the King of the Western River of the Henan state sent envoys presenting local products"—"King of the Western River" in all editions reads "King of the West River"; emended per the Annals of the Deposed Emperor, year 1 of Jingping, and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
translations.idiomatic: On "renshen, the King of the Western River of the Henan state sent envoys with tribute": all editions read West River for Western River; corrected per the Annals of the Deposed Emperor (Jingping 1) and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.

sentences.zh: 亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山 三朝本作「泰山」，弘治本、北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「秦梁」。

translations.literal: "The outlaw Ma Daxuan and his band of several hundred men raided Taishan"—the Three Reigns edition reads "Taishan"; the Hongzhi, Northern Directorate, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read "Qin and Liang."
translations.idiomatic: On "the outlaw Ma Daxuan and several hundred followers raided Taishan": the Three Reigns edition has Taishan; Hongzhi, Northern Directorate, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read Qin and Liang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉 按是月丁亥朔，無乙酉。

translations.literal: "Fourth month of summer, yiyou day"—comment: that month had dinghai as the new moon; there is no yiyou.
translations.idiomatic: On "fourth month of summer, yiyou day": that month began on dinghai—yiyou cannot occur.

sentences.zh: 二十三日己酉，「乙酉」或是「己酉」之譌。

translations.literal: The twenty-third day was jiyou; "yiyou" is probably a corruption for "jiyou."
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-third day was jiyou; yiyou is likely a scribal error for jiyou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉 「辛酉」各本並作「乙酉」，據南史改。

translations.literal: "Seventh month of autumn, xinyou day"—"xinyou" in all editions reads "yiyou"; emended per the Southern History.
translations.idiomatic: On "seventh month of autumn, xinyou day": all editions read yiyou for xinyou; corrected per the Southern History.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚戌朔，初六日辛酉，無「乙酉」。

translations.literal: Comment: that month had gengxu as the new moon; the sixth day was xinyou—there is no "yiyou."
translations.idiomatic: Note: that month began on gengxu; the sixth day was xinyou—yiyou is impossible.

sentences.zh: 於益州立南晉壽南新巴北巴西三郡 各本並作「於益州立南晉壽新巴西三郡」。

translations.literal: "In Yi Province the three commanderies Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established"—all editions read "In Yi Province the three commanderies Southern Jinshou, Xinba, and Baxi were established."
translations.idiomatic: On "three commanderies established in Yi Province: Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi": all editions read Southern Jinshou, Xinba, and Baxi only.

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「據州郡志，是南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。

translations.literal: Sun Ao's Critical Study of the Song History says: "According to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies, they are the commanderies Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ao's Critical Study of the Song History says: "Per the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies, the three are Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi.

sentences.zh: 」按孫說是，今訂正。

translations.literal: " Comment: Sun is correct; now emended.
translations.idiomatic: " Sun is right; the text is emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 又此條上云「壬申」，下云「乙亥」。

translations.literal: Moreover, in this entry above it says "renshen" and below "yihai."
translations.idiomatic: This entry also has renshen above and yihai below.

sentences.zh: 按是月丙戌朔，無壬申，亦無乙亥。

translations.literal: Comment: that month had bingxu as the new moon; there is neither renshen nor yihai.
translations.idiomatic: Note: that month began on bingxu—neither renshen nor yihai is possible.

sentences.zh: 以步兵校尉劉真道為梁南秦二州刺史 「劉真道」各本並作「劉道真」。

translations.literal: "The Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Zhendao was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces"—"Liu Zhendao" in all editions reads "Liu Daozhen."
translations.idiomatic: On "Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Zhendao made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin": all editions read Liu Daozhen for Liu Zhendao.

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「當作劉真道，見劉懷肅傳，下十八年亦作劉真道。

translations.literal: Zhang Senkai's collation note says: "It should read Liu Zhendao; see the biography of Liu Huaisu; year eighteen below also reads Liu Zhendao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai's collation note says: "The name should be Liu Zhendao, as in the biography of Liu Huaisu; year eighteen below also has Liu Zhendao.

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " Comment: Zhang is correct; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang is correct; the reading is adopted.

sentences.zh: 河南國河西王訶羅單國並遣使獻方物 「河西王」各本並作「西河王」，據少帝紀及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。

translations.literal: "The King of the Western River of the Henan state and the Heluodan state both sent envoys presenting local products"—"King of the Western River" in all editions reads "King of the West River"; emended per the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
translations.idiomatic: On "the King of the Western River of the Henan state and the Heluodan state both sent envoys with tribute": all editions read West River for Western River; corrected per the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.

sentences.zh: 燕王弘遣使獻方物 「弘」各本並作「年」，據晉書載記改。

translations.literal: "The Yan king Hong sent envoys presenting local products"—"Hong" in all editions reads "Nian"; emended per the annals section of the Jin History.
translations.idiomatic: On "Yan king Hong sent envoys with tribute": all editions read Nian for Hong; corrected per the annals of the Jin History.

sentences.zh: 今年有不收處 「年」各本並作「半」，據元龜四八九改。

translations.literal: "This year there are places of failed harvest"—"year" in all editions reads "half"; emended per Yuan Gui 489.
translations.idiomatic: On "this year there are places of failed harvest": all editions read half for year; corrected per Yuan Gui 489.

sentences.zh: 以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射 「王球」各本並作「王琳」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: "The Household Grandee Wang Qiu was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat"—"Wang Qiu" in all editions reads "Wang Lin"; emended per the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: On "Household Grandee Wang Qiu made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat": all editions read Wang Lin for Wang Qiu; corrected per the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「王球作王琳，是傳寫之譌。」

translations.literal: Hong Yixuan, Variorum Notes on the Histories, says: "Wang Qiu written as Wang Lin is a transmission error."
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yixuan, Variorum Notes on the Histories, says: "Writing Wang Qiu as Wang Lin is a copyist's mistake."

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午 「壬午」各本作「壬申」。

translations.literal: "Fifth month of summer, renwu day"—"renwu" in all editions reads "renshen."
translations.idiomatic: On "fifth month of summer, renwu day": all editions read renshen for renwu.

sentences.zh: 局本作「壬午」。

translations.literal: The Bureau edition reads "renwu."
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau edition has renwu.

sentences.zh: 按是月壬午朔，無壬申。

translations.literal: Comment: that month had renwu as the new moon; there is no renshen.
translations.idiomatic: Note: that month began on renwu—renshen cannot occur.

sentences.zh: 今從局本。

translations.literal: Now follow the Bureau edition.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau reading is adopted.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射王球卒 「球」各本並作「琳」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: "Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Qiu died"—"Qiu" in all editions reads "Lin"; emended per the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: On "Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Qiu died": all editions read Lin for Qiu; corrected per the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 是月 各本並作十二月。

translations.literal: "That month"—all editions read "twelfth month."
translations.idiomatic: On "that month": all editions read twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 按上已有十月，十一月，十二月，不當重出十二月。

translations.literal: Comment: above there are already the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months—a twelfth month should not appear again.
translations.idiomatic: Note: the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months already appear above—a second twelfth month is impossible.

sentences.zh: 今改作是月。

translations.literal: Now emended to read "that month."
translations.idiomatic: The text is changed to "that month."

sentences.zh: 盛王聖世 「聖」各本並作「祖」，據元龜一九四改。

translations.literal: "Flourishing kings, sage age"—"sage" in all editions reads "ancestor"; emended per Yuan Gui 194.
translations.idiomatic: On "flourishing kings, sage age": all editions read ancestor for sage; corrected per Yuan Gui 194.

sentences.zh: 始奉礿祠 「礿」各本並作「初」，據元龜二０七改。

translations.literal: "First to offer the yue sacrifice"—"yue" in all editions reads "first"; emended per Yuan Gui 207.
translations.idiomatic: On "first to offer the yue sacrifice": all editions read first for yue; corrected per Yuan Gui 207.

sentences.zh: 庚申 各本同。

translations.literal: "Gengshen"—all editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen: all editions agree.

sentences.zh: 按是月壬申朔，初三日甲戌，是月無庚申。

translations.literal: Comment: that month had renshen as the new moon; the third day was jiaxu—there is no gengshen in that month.
translations.idiomatic: Note: that month began on renshen; the third day was jiaxu—gengshen cannot fall in this month.

sentences.zh: 下有甲申，為十三日。

translations.literal: Below there is jiashen, the thirteenth day.
translations.idiomatic: Jiashen follows below as the thirteenth day.

sentences.zh: 甲戌、甲申之間有庚辰。

translations.literal: Between jiaxu and jiashen there is gengchen.
translations.idiomatic: Between jiaxu and jiashen stands gengchen.

sentences.zh: 庚申疑庚辰之譌。

translations.literal: Gengshen is probably a corruption for gengchen.
translations.idiomatic: Gengshen is likely a scribal error for gengchen.

sentences.zh: 南徐南豫州揚州之浙江西 各本同。

translations.literal: "Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the west of the Zhe River in Yang Province"—all editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: On "Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the west of the Zhe River in Yang Province": all editions agree.

sentences.zh: 南史於「南徐」下有「南兗」二字。

translations.literal: The Southern History has the two characters "Southern Yan" after "Southern Xu."
translations.idiomatic: The Southern History inserts Southern Yan after Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍 「駿」各本作「贊」，三朝本作「諱」。

translations.literal: "Inspector of Southern Yu Province, Prince of Wuling Jun, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army"—"Jun" in all editions reads "Zan"; the Three Reigns edition reads "taboo name."
translations.idiomatic: On "Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Southern Yu, additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army": all editions read Zan for Jun; the Three Reigns edition has taboo name.

sentences.zh: 按時武陵王駿，即後之孝武帝。

translations.literal: Comment: at the time Prince of Wuling Jun was the later Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Note: Prince of Wuling Jun at this date was the future Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 贊為宋明帝第九子，後亦封武陵王，時尚未生。

translations.literal: Zan was the ninth son of Emperor Ming of Song and was later also enfeoffed Prince of Wuling; he had not yet been born.
translations.idiomatic: Zan was Emperor Ming's ninth son and would later hold the same princely title; he was not yet born.

sentences.zh: 今改作「駿」。

translations.literal: Now emended to read "Jun."
translations.idiomatic: The text is corrected to Jun.

sentences.zh: 征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍荊州刺史 「南徐州刺史」各本並脫「南」字，據義宣傳補。

translations.literal: "Campaigning-North General, Inspector of Southern Xu Province, Prince of Nanqiao Xuan, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province"—"Inspector of Southern Xu Province" in all editions drops the character for South; supplied per the biography of Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On "Prince of Nanqiao Xuan, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province": all editions omit South in Southern Xu; restored per Xuan's biography.

sentences.zh: 九月己未 「己未」各本並作「乙未」，局本作「己未」。

translations.literal: "Ninth month, jiwei day"—"jiwei" in all editions reads "yimao"; the Bureau edition reads "jiwei."
translations.idiomatic: On "ninth month, jiwei day": all editions read yimao for jiwei; the Bureau edition has jiwei.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁巳朔，初三日己未，無乙未。

translations.literal: Comment: that month had dingsi as the new moon; the third day was jiwei—there is no yimao.
translations.idiomatic: Note: that month began on dingsi; the third day was jiwei—yimao is impossible.

sentences.zh: 今從局本。

translations.literal: Now follow the Bureau edition.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau reading is adopted.

sentences.zh: 遷漢川流民於沔次 「漢川」各本作「漢州」，按時無「漢州」，據元龜四八六改。

translations.literal: Relocated Han River refugees to the banks of the Han: on "Han River" all editions read "Han Prefecture"; but at the period there was no "Han Prefecture"—corrected according to Yuan Gui 486.
translations.idiomatic: On "relocated Han River refugees to the banks of the Han": every edition reads Han Prefecture for Han River; no Han Prefecture existed at the time; emended per Yuan Gui 486.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳 下有乙丑。

translations.literal: Third month, dingsi day: yichou follows below.
translations.idiomatic: On "third month, dingsi day": the text continues with yichou below.

sentences.zh: 各本同。

translations.literal: All editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: All received editions agree.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁卯朔，無丁巳，亦無乙丑。

translations.literal: Note: that month had dingmao as new moon; there was no dingsi, and no yichou.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: that month began on dingmao; neither dingsi nor yichou could occur.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申朔，二十二日丁巳，三十日乙丑。

translations.literal: Fourth month, bingshen new moon: the twenty-second day was dingsi; the thirtieth day was yichou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the new moon was bingshen; the twenty-second day was dingsi and the thirtieth yichou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥 各本並作「辛巳」。

translations.literal: Xinhai: all editions alike read xinsi.
translations.idiomatic: On "xinhai": all editions read xinsi.

sentences.zh: 通鑑考異云：「按長曆，二月壬辰朔，十日辛丑，二十日辛亥。

translations.literal: Zizhi Tongjian Collation of Variants states: "According to the Long Calendar, in the second month renchen was the new moon; the tenth day was xinchou; the twentieth day was xinhai.
translations.idiomatic: The Zizhi Tongjian Collation of Variants reads: "Per the Long Calendar, the second month's new moon was renchen; the tenth day was xinchou and the twentieth xinhai.

sentences.zh: 辛巳當作辛亥。

translations.literal: Xinsi should read xinhai.
translations.idiomatic: Xinsi should be xinhai.

sentences.zh: 」今據改。

translations.literal: " The present text is emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: " This emendation is adopted in the present text.

sentences.zh: 安北將軍徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍 「駿」宋本作「諱」。

translations.literal: Pacifying-North General and Inspector of the two provinces Xu and Yan, Prince of Wuling Jun, was reduced in rank to General Who Settles the Army: on "Jun" the Song edition reads "taboo name."
translations.idiomatic: On "Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, Prince of Wuling Jun reduced to General Who Settles the Army": the Song edition has taboo name for Jun.

sentences.zh: 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「贊」，今據孝武帝紀訂正。

translations.literal: The Three-Dynasties, Northern Supervisory, Mao, and Hall editions read "Zan"; the present text is corrected according to the Annals of Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: The Three-Dynasties, Northern Supervisory, Mao, and Hall editions read Zan; the text is corrected per the Annals of Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 說見本卷校勘記第三十條。

translations.literal: The explanation appears in collation note thirty of this juan.
translations.idiomatic: See collation note 30 in this juan.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉亡命司馬順則自號齊王據梁鄒城丁巳婆皇國戊戌河南王並遣使獻方物 按是年五月甲申朔，初二日乙酉，十五日戊戌，無丁巳。

translations.literal: Fifth month yiyou—the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city—dingsi—the state of Ba Huang—wuxu—the King of Henan—all sent envoys presenting local products: note— that year in the fifth month jiashen was the new moon; the second day was yiyou; the fifteenth day was wuxu; there was no dingsi.
translations.idiomatic: On the fused entry "fifth month yiyou…dingsi…wuxu…presenting local products": that year the fifth month began on jiashen—the second day was yiyou and the fifteenth wuxu—so dingsi cannot stand.

sentences.zh: 丁巳日支當有誤。

translations.literal: The dingsi day-entry must be erroneous.
translations.idiomatic: The dingsi date is corrupt.

sentences.zh: 居業未立 「立」各本並作「能」，據元龜一九五改。

translations.literal: Livelihoods not yet established: on "established" all editions alike read "able"; corrected according to Yuan Gui 195.
translations.idiomatic: On "livelihoods not yet established": all editions read able for established; emended per Yuan Gui 195.

sentences.zh: 戊午 各本並作「庚午」，據南史改。

translations.literal: Wuwu: all editions alike read gengwu; corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: On "wuwu": all editions read gengwu; corrected per the Nanshi.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚戌朔，無庚午。

translations.literal: Note: that month had gengxu as new moon; there was no gengwu.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: that month began on gengxu; gengwu did not occur.

sentences.zh: 初九日戊午。

translations.literal: The ninth day was wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: The correct date is the ninth day, wuwu.
